jobs.title: Learning and Development Program Specialist supporting Nvidia
jobs.description:
**Sustainable Talent** is partnering with **NVIDIA**, a global leader that has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 25 years. We are now looking for a **Learning and Development Program Specialist** to support Nvidia's growing team.

  

This is a full-time (W-2) **contract** role based in **Santa Clara, CA.** We offer competitive pay **$40/hr - $50/hr** based on factors like experience, education, location, etc. and provide full benefits, PTO, and amazing company culture!

  

Learning & Development Coordinators work closely with Learning Program Managers to support and deliver our learning programs. We are looking for someone who works independently and collaboratively, enjoys cross-functional partnerships, and brings solid experience in learning program management.

  

**What you will be doing:**

* Planning the learning calendar based on organizational needs.
* Coordinating 1:1 coaching programs end to end.
* Producing and managing online, live, and hybrid learning events.
* Handling program communications and LMS administration.
* Developing and curating learning resources and marketing materials.
* Preparing speakers and instructors for successful delivery.
* Tracking learning data and managing learner communities on Slack and Teams.
* Gathering feedback, managing deliverables, and mitigating risks to drive program adoption.

  

**What we need to see:**

* Someone who enjoys creative problem-solving and can take our client's learning roadmap from concept to execution, managing rollout, adoption, and ongoing maintenance along the way.
* **Background in adult learning:** degrees in Education, Psychology, or Communications, or equivalent experience in learning roles.
* Hands-on experience coordinating **global learning programs at scale** with an aptitude for experimentation and iteration.
* Proficiency with business and AI tools including Claude, ChatGPT, MS Office, Smartsheet, Lovable, and Canva.

  

**About Sustainable Talent**

Sustainable Talent is a certified woman-owned company specializing in recruitment, consulting, and workforce solutions. We partner with innovative organizations to connect exceptional talent with meaningful opportunities across technology, engineering, operations, and professional services.

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sustainable Talent is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Digital Literacy Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION:** Digital Literacy Program Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** Volunteer Program Manager

**THE ORGANIZATION:** Conard House, Inc. is a non-profit organization that focuses on empowering people and restoring hope for our community members and workforce. We work with a diverse adult population and strive for cultural competency by respecting experience, promoting inclusion and building community. The position is with the SF Connected program, which provides various services including: computer training, resume building, tablet training, social media training, and other services that improve the quality of life/independence of older adults and adults with disabilities in San Francisco. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Conard House is a committed equal opportunity employer.

**QUALIFICATIONS:** High School Diploma required; Bachelor's degree preferred. Must have at least two years of experience in a technology-focused, educational, or human services role working with diverse populations. Demonstrate the ability to clearly communicate ideas, information, and technical concepts to individuals and groups with varying levels of knowledge, education, and digital literacy, while providing troubleshooting, training, and technology guidance in a supportive and accessible manner. Demonstrate positive customer service and client-centered approaches when interacting with participants, staff, volunteers, and community members. Must be comfortable with public speaking, group facilitation, and delivering presentations, classes, or workshops. Demonstrate experience developing, implementing, and evaluating curriculum, educational materials, or training programs, as well as coordinating projects and collaborating effectively across diverse teams, departments, and community partners. Experience working with and supervising volunteers is highly desirable. Must complete a background check after conditional job offer.

**DUTIES:**

* Develop curriculum for classes that is suitable for Conard House consumers that will include usage of computers and commonly used software and apps.
* Train and assist consumers on assistive technologies and accessibility features to promote independence and enhance consumers’ daily living.
* Design and implement training programs that will help improve and enhance daily living for consumers.
* Assist consumers with job search process, including resume revision, cover letter composition, and online applications.
* Assist consumers with troubleshooting on personal tech devices, platforms, and processes. Maintain the ability to adjust approach(es) as needed to best suit consumer needs.
* Host/train consumers and volunteers on video conferencing platforms/software to allow clients to learn, participate/engage in virtual activities and virtual learning opportunities.
* Coordinate workshops, guest speakers, and special events that promote digital inclusion and community engagement.
* Deliver personalized strength-based training; encourage and support participant interaction.
* Coordinate, train, support, and oversee volunteers and interns assisting with Digital Literacy programming.
* Develop and disseminate program materials to all Conard sites.
* Conduct program outreach, both internally at associated Conard sites as well as with potential and established external partners.
* Coordinate class scheduling with site supervisors in the community.
* Design group activities that promote social connection opportunities for consumers.
* Track program objectives and class attendance, including individual usage and student progress.
* Collect & compile data for distribution of monthly reports and input data into the appropriate database.
* Coordinate Digital Literacy program inventory, including ordering and tracking incoming and outgoing devices.
* Maintain accurate program records and ensure compliance with agency, contract, and confidentiality requirements.
* Manage technology equipment, coordinate security of equipment at sites, report issues with equipment or lab operations.
* Coordinate and network with other agencies that are participating in SF Connected. Attend meetings as required.
* Maintain a classroom environment suitable for collaborative learning.
* Be available to assist consumers virtually and remotely.
* Others duties as assigned.

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 403(b)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

jobs.description:

You will work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to improve operational efficiency, develop templates and training resources, and maintain key knowledge bases.

Please note, this role requires an onsite cadence of 3 days/week in our Foster City, CA office.

### **In this role, you will...**

* Lead the development, alignment, and tracking of company strategic focus areas.
* Drive executive operations by leading executive forum planning, shaping meeting agendas and content, and managing action tracking for leadership meetings and offsites.
* Support the development of monthly and quarterly company reporting documentation, synthesizing strategic initiatives, business performance metrics, and cross-functional updates into executive-ready deliverables.
* Manage and elevate the company’s VIP Visitor Program, delivering high-impact experiences.
* Lead complex cross-functional initiatives focused on operational scalability, process optimization, and organizational effectiveness through development of standardized workflows, dashboards, reporting frameworks, and visibility tools.

Ideal candidates have served in senior program manager roles with significant exposure to executive leadership teams.

### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, CEO/COO office roles, project management, operations, chief of staff or a similar role.
* Experience with program management frameworks, strategic planning, and business operations.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, presentation, and business writing skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.
* Proven track record of leveraging AI to drive operational excellence in executive operations.
* Ability to synthesize complex strategic information into cohesive narratives (not just reporting data)

### **Bonus Qualifications:**

* Experience in autonomous vehicle (AV) or technology industries.
* Familiarity with corporate governance and executive reporting.
* Extensive experience with Google Suite, Confluence and Jira.
* Strategic planning & KIP design

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
jobs.description:
***The Company***

Halo Industries has developed breakthrough technology to revolutionize a decades-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser-based solution minimizes waste, enhances material cost efficiency, and drives innovations across high-growth markets, including automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo received significant funding in 2024, paving the way for rapid expansion, strategic customer engagement, and the launch of volume manufacturing.

***The Opportunity***

We are seeking a highly strategic and technical Supply Chain Program Manager to join our supply chain team. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing and managing both the highly specialized raw materials required for our wafers and the critical electromechanical components needed to build our proprietary manufacturing equipment.

You will also develop comprehensive sourcing strategies, manage robust supplier relationships, drive cost and quality improvements, and lead complex procurement processes.

***Key Responsibilities***

Strategic Sourcing & Category Management

* Develop and Execute Commodity Strategies: Create comprehensive, multi-year sourcing strategies for raw materials and capital equipment sub-components.
* Market Intelligence: Continuously monitor global market conditions, raw material indices, and geopolitical factors impacting the semiconductor and supply chains. Conduct deep market research and analysis to identify technological trends, evaluate supplier capabilities, and proactively identify potential global risks within assigned commodity categories
* Dual-Sourcing Initiatives: Identify, qualify, and onboard primary and secondary suppliers to mitigate risk and eliminate single points of failure in the supply chain.

Supplier Relationship Management

* Contract Negotiation: Lead complex negotiations for Master Supply Agreements, Statements of Work, and pricing contracts.
* Performance Monitoring: Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews with key suppliers to evaluate performance against rigorous Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Innovation metrics.
* Capacity Planning: Work closely with suppliers to ensure their manufacturing capacity aligns with our long-term production forecasts and equipment build schedules.
* Supplier Relations: Research, select, and manage strategic suppliers; conduct performance reviews, monitor KPIs (quality, delivery), and negotiate contracts.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* New Product Introduction: Partner with R&D and the NPI Team during the design phase of new tools to ensure Design for Manufacturability and supply chain viability.
* Cost Reduction: Collaborate with engineering and manufacturing to identify Value Analysis/Value Engineering opportunities, thereby driving down the Bill of Materials cost
* Escalation Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for critical supply shortages, leading cross-functional task forces to resolve bottlenecks and prevent production downtime.
* Program Management: Collaborate daily with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, NPI, and Finance teams to align commodity strategies with overall business objectives, production schedules, and product design phases. Participate in corporate continuous improvement initiatives to enhance end-to-end supply chain processes, reduce lifecycle costs, and mitigate risks.

  
**Requirements**

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering (Mechanical, Materials Science, or Electrical), Business, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain within the semiconductor, capital equipment, or advanced materials industries.
* Proficiency reading engineering drawings and understand complex technical specifications related to both raw materials (purity levels, material properties) and equipment components (tolerances, vacuum standards).
* Experience performing complex cost modeling, Should-Cost analysis, and Total Cost of Ownership evaluations.
* Experience utilizing ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) and PLM software (e.g., Arena).
* Direct experience in the semiconductor or related high-tech industries.
* Direct experience supporting New Product Introductions (NPI), including supplier selection and qualification for engineering prototypes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced negotiation skills with a history of executing favorable long-term contracts in volatile markets.

* Experience developing and executing successful, long-term global commodity sourcing strategies for specialized materials or capital equipment components.
* Familiarity with global supply chain management complexity, geopolitical factors, and risk mitigation planning.
* Experience with the complexities of compliance driven procurement for automotive or IATF 16949.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

**Other Requirements**

* This is a full-time role primarily based onsite at our Santa Clara, CA office.
* Some domestic and international travel may be required (up to 10%).

 **Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Free Food & Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* Annual Bonus Plan eligible
* Short Term & Long Term Disability

* Base Salary: $140,000 - $160,000

*Additional Information*

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Lab Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life-threatening diseases. Eikon's discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets.

**Position**  
As the Lab Ops Supervisor, you will oversee day-to-day operations of our chemistry labs, supervise 1 direct report (lab support technician), directly report to the Senior Director, and work closely with research teams to ensure optimal lab performance. You will be responsible for maintaining laboratory equipment, managing chemical inventory and solvent preparation, enforcing safety protocols, and fostering a collaborative work environment.

**About you**  
A highly organized and proactive professional with strong communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills. Able to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and effectively support laboratory operations and scientific teams. Adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic research environment.

**What You'll Do:**

* Supervise and assist laboratory technicians by delegating tasks and regularly monitoring their progress to ensure the completion of assignments and the efficient use of resources.
* Carry out designated routine activities.
* Ensure the upkeep and calibration of laboratory equipment, guaranteeing its constant readiness for operation.
* Manage and track equipment inventory and equipment monitoring.
* Prepare and maintain solvent and reagent stock solutions to support daily lab operations.
* Maintain accurate chemical inventory, including tracking stock levels, expiration dates, proper labeling, and storage.
* Handle and coordinate the disposal of hazardous chemical waste in compliance with EPA, OSHA, and other applicable regulations.
* Manage procurement of lab supplies and chemicals, including vendor coordination and purchase orders.
* Enforce lab safety rules, hazardous material handling, and waste disposal practices.
* Develop and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for lab processes and safety protocols.
* Evaluate laboratory performance and advise on improvements to optimize efficiency.
* Promote teamwork, provide guidance, and help your team grow professionally.

This position requires participation in an on-call rotation for one week per month.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree with 2+ years of experience in a related scientific field (Biology, Chemistry, etc.).
* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry preferred.
* Proven leadership experience in a lab setting.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Good communication skills for working with your team and researchers.
* Knowledge of lab safety protocols and equipment handling.
* Comfortable using lab software and data analysis tools.
* A commitment to maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

At Eikon, employee compensation also includes bonus and equity compensation, in addition to several generous benefit programs, including:

* 401k plan with company matching
* Medical (premiums covered by Eikon at 95%), dental and vision insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%)
* Mental health and wellness benefits
* Weeklong summer and winter holiday shutdowns
* Generous paid time off and holiday policies
* Life/AD&D Insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) and optional supplemental employee-paid life/AD&D policies
* Enhanced parental leave benefit
* Daily subsidized lunch program when on-site

The expected salary range for this role is $95,000 to $105,000 depending on skills, competency, and the market demand for your expertise.

Eikon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment.

We are currently not accepting any new third-party agencies or firms at this time. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website, employees or Human Resources. Eikon Therapeutics will not pay fees to any third-party agency or firm associated with unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**

Established in Taiwan in 1974, Hon Hai Technology Group, commonly known as Foxconn, is the world’s largest electronics manufacturer and leading provider of technological solutions with a network of over 233 campuses across 24 countries. In the US, Foxconn employs 8,000 across 56 different sites with manufacturing operations in Virginia, Wisconsin, Ohio, Indiana, Texas, and California. As of 2025, Foxconn ranks 28th among the Fortune Global 500 and reported revenue of approximately USD $259 billion.

The company’s diverse product offerings span four major segments: smart consumer electronics, cloud, and networking solutions, computing, and various other components. Foxconn makes 40% of the consumer electronics that we find in our everyday lives. In recent years, Hon Hai has adopted the 3+3 strategy, focusing on three emerging industries - electric vehicles, digital health solutions, and robotics - while leveraging three key technologies: next-generation communications, artificial intelligence (AI), and semiconductors. Together, these initiatives position the company as a leader in innovation for the 21st century.

Hon Hai Technology Group is deeply committed to championing environmental sustainability within its manufacturing processes. By integrating sustainability into its operations framework, the company strives to serve as a best-practice model for global enterprises, enhancing corporate responsibility while meeting the growing demand for environmentally conscious production methods.

jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

We are interested in candidates who are looking for long-term employment and find a homebase for their career.

**SUMMARY**

Sunrise is a thriving event venue located in Vacaville, CA. We host a wide variety of events ranging from Weddings & Quinceaneras to Corporate Meetings & Community Galas.

The ideal candidate would be highly organized, a natural leader, possess excellent communication skills, stay calm in stressful situations, and be able to juggle a wide array of responsibilities. As Event Operations Manager you must be present for and oversee all events in order to ensure a high level of guest satisfaction and seamless event coordination. You will ensure everything is accounted for before, during, & after each event.

You will serve as liaison and contact person for coordinating details of events with clients, outside vendors, meeting planners, chefs, decorators, DJs and others.

This is a salaried Position and although your schedule revolves around our events, expect to consistently work around 40-50 hours a week. Sunrise provides an exciting and Dynamic work environment so don't expect to be tethered to your desk - especially during events when you will be on your feet constantly. Typically you will be working 2-3 weekdays in order to effectively complete administrative tasks and plan for events. The remainder of your work schedule will be on Friday, Saturday, & Sundays during the events themselves (3pm - 1am typically).

There is room for growth in this company; this is the perfect opportunity to display your skills in the hospitality/events industry and find a reliable foundation for your career.

jobs.title: Immigration Program Manager (Operations)
jobs.description:
SummaryMeta is seeking an operations manager within its immigration program to lead the operating model for complex Talent Acquisition programs and the processes recruiting runs on. This person decides where the function should invest its process and program effort, sets the standards that recruiting teams work to, and carries the judgment calls on compliance risk, standardization, and sequencing. They will work from hiring priorities rather than defined project briefs, and they are accountable for outcomes across a stakeholder set they do not manage.The role also carries functional ownership of Meta's PERM recruitment process: a specialized, compliance-critical domain where this person is the company's internal authority on process and operations. We are looking for an experienced TA program and process owner who can hold that compliance line. Deep PERM expertise is valuable but can be built with support from the Immigration team and outside counsel.  
  
  

### **Immigration Program Manager (Operations) Responsibilities:**

* Portfolio and Operating Model Ownership
* Define, plan and execute complex TA programs and cross-functional initiatives. Identify which problems are worth solving, make the case for them, and sequence them against hiring priorities and capacity
* Set the operating model for how TA programs are scoped, governed, launched, and transitioned to steady state, and hold teams to it
* Own the relationship with outside counsel on PERM matters, setting the agenda on program-level strategy and taking a position on individual case strategy rather than relaying it
* Define the roles, responsibilities, and controls within the PERM recruitment process, then build the processes that drive sustained adherence across TA, Hiring Managers, and TA Operations
* Set the direction for the PERM Recruitment Enhancement initiative, including scope, risk appetite, and the standard the redesigned process must meet
* Serve as function manager for Meta's Talent Center PERM recruitment process, owning process health, compliance posture, and outcomes
* PERM Recruitment Program Ownership
* Initiate permanent residence cases with outside counsel and manage case progression against filing timelines
* Own the documentation standard for PERM (immigrant visa) filings, and ensure the process remains audit-ready by design rather than by remediation
* Act as the internal authority and escalation point for the Immigration team, foreign national employees, and HR partners on PERM questions
* Translate ambiguous or competing hiring priorities into a multi-quarter roadmap, and make the trade-off calls when priorities conflict
* Own the measures of success for the portfolio, including clearly defined success criteria and performance benchmarks
* Build mechanisms that let programs run without you: clear ownership, documentation, performance measures, and review cadence
* Process Architecture and Operational Excellence
* Own the end-to-end design of priority TA processes: workforce demand intake, requisition launch, sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offer management, preboarding, and recruiting operations
* Decide where processes should be standardized in ways that improve speed, quality, consistency and compliance and be able to defend those decisions to stakeholders
* Diagnose root causes behind systemic process failure rather than individual bottlenecks, and distinguish problems worth fixing from noise
* Set decision rights, handoffs, service expectations, escalation paths, and operating mechanisms across recruiting teams, including where those boundaries sit with Finance, Legal, and IT
* Establish the playbooks, SOPs, and governance practices that become the reference standard for recruiting execution
* Define the requirements that recruiting technology and ATS workflows must meet, and hold systems partners to them
* Build the data and feedback mechanisms that make continuous improvement a property of the function rather than a project activity
* Influence and Stakeholder Leadership
* Advise TA and business leaders on process and program strategy, including when their stated ask is not the right one
* Drive accountability across recruiters, coordinators, sourcers, hiring managers, interviewers, systems teams, Finance, Legal, and IT without direct authority
* Resolve contested design decisions across concurrent workstreams, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a question
* Raise the capability of other program and operations practitioners through mentoring, review, and reusable standards

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in recruiting operations, TA program management, HR operations, or a comparable program and process ownership role
* Track record of owning a program or process domain end to end as the accountable individual
* Experience setting direction in ambiguity: defining the problem, building the case for investment, and sequencing work against competing priorities
* Experience designing operational processes that were adopted beyond the team that built them, with measurable improvement
* Change management experience at a scale where adoption, not delivery, was the hard part
* Experience advising and influencing senior leaders, including redirecting a stated ask
* Experience owning the requirements and standards that recruiting technology and ATS workflows are held to, and using operational data to drive decisions
* Experience owning a compliance posture in a regulated or audit-exposed environment, including the judgment on where risk is acceptable
* Ability to make complex requirements legible to non-expert audiences and to senior decision makers

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Working knowledge of how PERM recruitment obligations interact with non-discrimination and IER requirements
* Direct PERM labor certification experience, including recruitment requirements, prevailing wage determinations, audit response, and documentati

jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

As Senior Director of Worldwide Deal Desk at Snowflake, you'll be central to the company's growth. You'll partner closely with Sales leadership to structure, review, approve and negotiate our most complex and strategic opportunities. You'll lead a global team of Deal Desk professionals who connect Sales with Legal, Finance, Revenue Accounting, Services and Operations, so deals close quickly, compliantly and profitably. You'll also lead the Deal Desk's shift to an AI-native organization, using Snowflake's own AI capabilities to change how deals get built, reviewed and approved.

**AS A SENIOR DIRECTOR, WW DEAL DESK AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:**
==============================================================

* Lead, scale and develop a global team of Deal Desk professionals that supports Sales across all regions and time zones.
* Be a trusted advisor to Sales leadership on deal structure, pricing, discounting and negotiation strategy for complex, high-value consumption and multi-year agreements.
* Coordinate cross-functional input from Sales, Legal, Revenue Accounting, Finance, Services, Operations, Product and Engineering to move deals from structure to signature efficiently.
* Own deal review and approval governance, making sure deals follow company policies, revenue recognition requirements and risk thresholds.
* Partner with Finance, Legal and RevOps leadership to define and evolve policies, approval matrices and deal processes, and drive their adoption across the field.
* Define and report on Deal Desk KPIs (deal cycle time, approval SLAs, discount trends, non-standard term usage, etc.) to give executives insight into deal health and commercial risk.
* Lead the AI transformation of the Deal Desk. Working with Data Analytics and Enterprise Technology, build an AI-native organization: deploy AI agents and copilots for deal structuring guidance, pricing recommendations, contract review and redlining, approval routing, and deal risk scoring.
* Champion AI adoption across the team. Build AI fluency, redesign workflows around automation, and measure the impact on productivity, cycle time and deal quality.

**OUR IDEAL SENIOR DIRECTOR, WW DEAL DESK WILL HAVE:**
======================================================

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 15+ years of experience across deal desk, procurement, sales finance, commercial finance, pricing, contract negotiation or sales operations, including significant time leading global teams.
* Deep experience structuring and negotiating complex enterprise contracts with long sales cycles.
* Ability to read, interpret and draft commercial terms and conditions.
* Strong understanding of revenue recognition (ASC 606) and US GAAP.
* Strong knowledge of SaaS and consumption-based business models, including commit, capacity and usage-based pricing.
* Demonstrated AI proficiency: hands-on experience applying generative AI, LLM-based tools or automation to finance, sales operations or deal workflows, plus a clear view of where AI does and doesn't belong in governance-heavy processes.
* Track record of designing and rolling out complex finance systems, processes and tools (for example CPQ, CLM, CRM).
* Ability to break down complex issues and explain them clearly to everyone from frontline sellers to the C-suite.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation and executive stakeholder skills.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, high deal velocity and quarter-end pressure, and motivated by helping Sales win.

**DESIRED SKILLS/EXPERTISE:**
=============================

* Track record of driving cross-functional alignment and managing strategic relationships across Sales, Legal and Finance.
* Proven experience designing deal approval governance and commercial risk mitigation frameworks.
* Strong leadership in hiring, coaching and developing talent across distributed global teams.
* Experience leading AI or automation programs that delivered measurable gains in efficiency or quality.
* Familiarity with data platforms and analytics (Snowflake experience a plus).
* MBA or equivalent work experience.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

* The estimated base salary range for this role is $260,000 - $341,200.
* Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holiday

**Company Description**

**Who is Turner & Townsend?**

All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data centre they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.

**Our purpose:**

**Transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world.**

The world is changing and we have a responsibility to support that change, helping drive it and be part of it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust between clients, suppliers, governments and society. Delivering better outcomes that have a positive impact on the world around us. We work smarter to face the challenges of the future; bringing the clarity that helps teams realise their full potential across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors. It’s how we’ve made the difference for more than 75 years.

**Our values:**

**Love a challenge:** We love a challenge and we work hard to make change happen and see things through. We don’t stand still, challenging ourselves and others to do better every day. And we are trusted to do the right thing, raising standards all the time.

**Stronger together:** We’re stronger together by connecting people in diverse teams, so that we can all collaborate to deliver our best work. We focus on what matters and use our influence to build a better world for everyone.

**Bring out the best in everyone:** We bring out the best in everyone. We help each other to make the most of our potential, always learning from our experience. We treat each other with care and respect and make time to give everyone a voice

 **Job Description**

**Turner & Townsend** are seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager** to join our team. The ideal individual will have prior experience supporting large-scale construction projects.

Responsibilities:

* Manage stakeholders including architects, engineers, and supply chains to deliver compliant projects.
* Can analyze, track, and effectively manage critical milestone activities to avoid schedule slips.
* Verify that effective project governance, processes and systems are utilized
* Ensure application of best practice on all projects.
* Production of formal project status reports and other reports as required.
* Monitor the progress of multiple construction projects simultaneously to ensure that the approved design standards are applied correctly.
* Manage the interface between all suppliers through monthly trackers and weekly reviews.
* Manage the flow of project information between the project team through regular meetings and written communications.
* Forecast and update key project milestones.
* Manage and monitor local design teams in accordance with commission criteria.
* Provide technical support to owners, architects, general contractors and regional stakeholders.
* Rapid response to RFIs from the field.
* Provide expertise for cost control, value engineering, and constructability guidance where required.
* Independent review of status reports, drawing submittals, timelines and costs from architects, contractors and suppliers.
* Client management – assist in developing excellent working relationships with Clients, with a view towards maximizing new opportunities.
* Strategic Thinking - provides advice to project teams on approaches that can be adopted to successfully achieve both clients’ objectives and business objectives.
* Knowledge management – ensure that key information and learnings generated from each project are captured.
* Process improvement – Identify ways to improve internal systems and processes
* SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in construction management, civil engineering, or applicable bachelor’s degree and or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 5-7 years of relevant project management experience.
* Strong organizational and management skills – the ability to work effectively and collaboratively with the broader team.
* Effective presentation skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Procore, and construction project management tools.
* Excellent communication skills.

  
**Additional Information**

**The salary range for this full-time role is** **$150K-$190K** **per year. Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package. Please note Turner & Townsend reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications.**

jobs.title: HCM Program Manager
jobs.description:
RingCentral is looking for an HCM Program Manager to drive delivery of our Human Capital Management initiatives, from new module rollouts to upgrades, integrations, and process improvements. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll be the hands-on owner who keeps HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and our HCM vendor aligned and moving, and who makes sure what we launch actually gets adopted.  
This is an in-house role. You won't be handing off to a client at go-live; you'll live with the platform and keep making it better. Reports to [Hiring Manager Title, e.g. Director of HR Technology / HRIS Manager].  
What you'll do

* Drive end-to-end delivery of HCM initiatives, including module implementations (Payroll, Time & Attendance, Benefits, Talent, Recruiting), upgrades, and vendor releases
* Build and maintain integrated plans across related workstreams, tracking timelines, dependencies, risks, and budget
* Run the operating rhythm: status reporting, working sessions, and steering committee updates for HR, Finance, and IT leadership
* Gather requirements from HR, Payroll, and business partners and translate them into clear scope, configuration needs, and success criteria
* Partner day-to-day with the HCM vendor and implementation partner, holding them to scope, timelines, and SOW commitments
* Coordinate integrations with adjacent systems such as ERP/GL, benefits carriers, LMS, ATS, and identity management
* Own testing and data migration execution, including end-to-end, parallel payroll, and user acceptance testing
* Lead change management, training, and communications so employees, managers, and HR teams adopt new processes
* Plan and run cutovers and go-lives, then manage hypercare and transition to ongoing support
* Surface risks early, escalate with options, and contribute to the HCM roadmap based on what you learn after launch

What you bring  
**Required**

* 5+ years of project or program management experience
* Hands-on experience driving at least one full-cycle HCM implementation on a platform such as UKG, ADP, Dayforce, Workday, Oracle, or SuccessFactors
* Working knowledge of core HR processes: hire-to-retire, payroll, time and attendance, benefits, and compensation
* Experience managing vendors and implementation partners against scope and SOW commitments
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence, without direct authority
* Strong command of project management tools and methods (Smartsheet, Jira, MS Project, or similar; Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid)
* Comfort handling sensitive employee data and working within privacy and compliance requirements
* Clear, confident communicator who can brief leadership and run a working session with equal ease

**Nice to have**

* PMP, CSM, or equivalent certification
* Platform certification (e.g., UKG Pro, ADP Workforce Now, Dayforce)
* Multi-state or international payroll experience
* Background in change management (Prosci or similar)

jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

**Program Manager, Value Optimization (S2P)**

*Draft job description for review. S2P Reimagined Transformation Office.*

**Role summary**

Owns the business value layer of the S2P Reimagined program, the initiative that pushes the boundary of how Global Procurement designs and runs its future processes. Serves as the business owner and single point of contact who translates S2P priorities into a prioritized, measured set of initiatives, and operationalizes process intelligence as a strategic layer across S2P. Process intelligence is enabled today by the P2P Celonis instance and expands across S2P as the capability matures. This is a business value and program leadership role. The role owns the requirements, KPIs, initiative pipeline, and value; the DTAI platform team owns the technical build and administration.

**Responsibilities**

* **Own the business value layer of S2P Reimagined.** Act as the business owner who operationalizes process intelligence as a strategic layer across the program, enabled today by the P2P Celonis instance and expanding across S2P.
* **Drive all Towers toward the S2P North Star.** Set targets, deliver actionable insight into prioritized initiatives, and govern the initiative pipeline, while the Towers own executing their initiatives.
* **Turn insight into executable, measured initiatives.** Convert process intelligence into scoped initiatives that are actively tracked against the North Star.
* **Own the North Star KPI framework.** Own the S2P North Star KPIs, baselines, and cost per transaction methodology as the single source of truth, signed off with finance and S2P leadership, and reconcile process intelligence outputs with finance and operational reporting so the program runs from one set of numbers.
* **Maintain an integrated, real time metric view.** Provide a live view of program metrics that leadership and the Towers work from.
* **Serve as the single point of contact for the Towers.** Intake, qualify, and prioritize process intelligence demand from Towers and business owners, and convert approved demand into scoped projects with defined deliverables and success criteria.
* **Represent S2P to the technical team.** Translate S2P priorities and requirements into platform improvements in partnership with DTAI, resolving data discrepancies and validating metrics such as touchless rate. Today this runs through the P2P Celonis instance and extends across S2P as the capability grows.
* **Proactively surface new opportunities.** Identify new initiatives and opportunities to explore as part of the program.

**How this role works with the platform team**

The Value Optimization PM is the business owner of process intelligence: the requirements, the KPIs, the initiative pipeline, and the value realized. The DTAI platform team owns the platform, data readiness, and technical build. This role sets what the process intelligence must answer and what the business acts on; it does not administer the tool. Celonis is the current enabling platform, not the scope of the role.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, engineering, finance, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* 7 or more years in procurement, source to pay, finance, or process transformation, including program or portfolio management of cross functional initiatives.
* Experience owning KPI frameworks, baselining, and cost or value methodology, with the ability to reconcile operational data against finance.
* Working knowledge of process mining and analytics (Celonis a plus) and of S2P systems such as SAP and Ariba, with the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.
* Proven ability to influence and govern across teams and to drive initiatives to measured value without direct authority over delivery teams.
* Experience communicating at the executive and steering committee level across a global organization.
* Familiarity with AI and agentic automation concepts and their operational and cost implications a plus.

We are hiring a **fixed-term GTM Enablement Partner** to support our GTM Enablement team during a planned parental leave. In this role, you'll partner with Customer Success, Sales, and the broader GTM Enablement team to keep enablement programs running smoothly — maintaining existing initiatives, coordinating logistics for training and events, and supporting the delivery of learning resources across the customer lifecycle. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in project management and cross-functional coordination and wants hands-on experience in a high-performing enablement organization.

**This is a fixed-term, full-time exempt position based in our Oakland, California office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home Tu/Fr. The expected term is approximately 6–7 months, with the possibility of conversion to a permanent role depending on business needs.**

### **Getting started**

* **We want you to feel like part of the team early on!** Our onboarding process will integrate you into the company with informative sessions on our product, policies, processes, and team structure and goals.

* Manage the logistics and execution of enablement programs, trainings, and events for our GTM Customer Success team

* **You're a strong project manager and coordinator.** You've managed cross-functional programs or events with multiple stakeholders and moving parts, and you keep things organized and on schedule.
* **You're process- and detail-oriented.** You find structure in ambiguity so that others can follow along, and you balance the details with the big picture.
* **You're a clear communicator.** You can distill information into something digestible for different audiences, both verbally and in writing.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of program management experience within design or UX organizations.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with the product development lifecycle.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." UX Programs & Operations drives projects by increasing communication, streamlining the UX design process, and fostering a culture of user-centered development. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, to create industry-leading products based on user insights.  
  
As a UX Program Manager, you will combine expert project management with a passion for user experience to improve the design of products used by billions. Your role is to plan projects, define milestones, assess risks, create actionable insights, and ensure deadlines are met. You will harmonize the work of various UX disciplines and cross-functional partners to drive team objectives and create innovative experiences.

You will independently develop and execute plans for end-to-end UX programs of moderate complexity, balancing big-picture product goals with day-to-day operational execution. By combining working knowledge of UX craft, research methodologies, and modern AI-enabled workflows, you will spot cross-project patterns, proactively mitigate risks, and create the conditions for UXers to do their best work at scale.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $132000 - $189000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

--------------------

jobs.title: Home care Case Manager / Client care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Make a Difference Every Day!**

At Home Helpers of Santa Clara Valley, we believe everyone deserves to live safely, comfortably, and independently in the place they call home. We are looking for a compassionate, proactive, and highly organized **Client Care Coordinator** to join our team and help ensure exceptional care and service for our clients and their families.

This position is ideal for a professional with experience in home care, healthcare coordination, or case management who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, coordinating services, and making a meaningful difference in the lives of older adults and individuals with disabilities.

The Client Care Coordinator will oversee the client care process from the initial assessment and development of individualized service plans through ongoing monitoring, quality assurance, and client relationship management. The role requires a combination of office-based coordination, client and family communication, and regular field visits.

**Candidates with previous home care or healthcare care-coordination experience are strongly encouraged to apply.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Client Assessments and Care Planning**

* Conduct initial in-home assessments to evaluate clients' needs, preferences, living environments, and safety concerns.
* Develop individualized, written service plans that reflect each client's needs, goals, preferences, and authorized non-medical services.
* Conduct reassessments and update service plans as client conditions, preferences, or circumstances change.
* Ensure intake paperwork, service agreements, and required documentation are completed before services begin.

**2. Client and Family Relationship Management**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, families, and authorized representatives regarding care coordination and service-related questions.
* Conduct regular quality assurance calls and in-home visits to assess client satisfaction and the effectiveness of services.
* Review caregiver visit notes and communicate with caregivers and families to identify changes in client needs or concerns.
* Address client complaints and service concerns promptly, document all communications, and coordinate appropriate follow-up and resolution.
* Build trust with clients and families through proactive communication, responsiveness, and compassionate service.

**3. Caregiver Coordination and Service Quality**

* Partner with the Staffing Coordinator to match clients with caregivers based on client needs, preferences, schedules, and caregiver qualifications.
* Communicate client-specific needs, service plan expectations, household preferences, and safety considerations to assigned caregivers.
* Review caregiver daily visit notes and identify concerns, missed tasks, or changes that may require follow-up.
* Collaborate with the staffing team to monitor Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) exceptions, including missed clock-ins, late arrivals, and other scheduling concerns.
* Help coordinate emergency coverage and communicate service changes to minimize interruptions in care.
* Reinforce appropriate non-medical care boundaries and agency policies, including medication reminders rather than medication administration, as applicable to the authorized service plan.

**4. Compliance, Documentation, and Quality Assurance**

* Maintain accurate, timely, and complete client records, assessments, service plans, visit notes, incident reports, and communication logs in the agency's care management system.
* Ensure documentation and client care practices comply with applicable California Department of Social Services (CDSS) requirements, HIPAA privacy requirements, Joint Commission standards, and agency policies.
* Identify potential safety risks, service concerns, or changes in client condition and escalate them to the appropriate team members.
* Support internal quality assurance initiatives, record reviews, audits, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Protect confidential client information and follow established privacy and security procedures.

**5. Community Partnerships and Special Programs**

* Build and maintain professional relationships with referral sources, healthcare professionals, senior living communities, and community organizations.
* Coordinate with community partners and program representatives regarding referrals, service schedules, and appropriate non-medical client updates.
* Help clients and families identify appropriate community resources and support services.
* Contribute to client satisfaction, retention, and the continued growth of the agency's referral network.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

* **Experience:** At least 1 year of experience in home care coordination, healthcare case management, client care management, or a closely related healthcare service role. Candidates with substantial relevant experience in home care are preferred.
* **Home Care Knowledge:** Understanding of non-medical home care operations, client assessments, individualized service plans, caregiver coordination, and client safety.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and compassionately with older adults, families, caregivers, and community partners.
* **Organization:** Strong organizational, time-management, multitasking, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* **Technology:** Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace and comfort using scheduling, documentation, and care management software. Experience with WellSky or ClearCare is a plus.
* **Compliance:** Familiarity with HIPAA, California home care regulations, and Home Care Aide Registry requirements is preferred.
* **Education:** A degree in nursing, social work, gerontology, healthcare administration, or a related field is a plus but not required.
* **Bilingual Skills:** Bilingual candidates(Spanish) are strongly preferred to better serve our diverse client pop

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Associate
jobs.description:
**About SleepRes**

SleepRes is developing next-generation sleep apnea therapy technologies that improve patient outcomes. We are a small, fast-moving R&D team focused on building high-quality medical devices that make a real-world impact.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Assurance (QA) Associate supports the daily operation and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) for Class II medical devices. Reporting to the Quality Manager, this role coordinates document control, manages day-to-day training program activities, administers the electronic QMS (eQMS), and supports customer feedback and complaint handling.

The QA Associate works with Quality, Regulatory, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Care to maintain accurate, complete, and audit-ready records. This is an individual contributor role that supports design control, risk management, and medical device software compliance under the Quality Manager's direction.

**Responsibilities**

**Document Control**

* Administer document control activities within the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS), including document creation, review, approval routing, release, revision, distribution, obsolescence, and archival in accordance with approved procedures.

* Maintain document numbering, revision history, effective dates, controlled templates, and applicable external standards within the eQMS, ensuring obsolete or superseded documents are appropriately controlled and protected from unintended use.

* Review documents and change records for completeness, formatting, required approvals, and associated training assignments; follow up on open actions.

**Training Program Management**

* Administer the company training program through the eQMS, including maintenance of the training matrix, role-based curricula, onboarding requirements, recurring training, and training triggered by new or revised controlled documents.

* Support onboarding and role changes by ensuring employees are assigned the appropriate eQMS training curricula based on job responsibilities.

* Assign and track training in the eQMS, follow up on overdue assignments, and report completion status to the Quality Manager and department leads.

* Maintain training and competency records, including evidence of training effectiveness where required by procedures.

**eQMS Administration**

* Support eQMS day-to-day administration, including approved user access, workflows, document and training modules, and user assistance.

* Support controlled configuration changes, data migration, testing, and validation documentation under approved plans; escalate system and data integrity issues.

Feedback and Complaint Support

* Log customer feedback and complaints, obtain missing information, and maintain traceability to the device, serial number, event, and supporting records.

* Coordinate follow-up with Customer Care, Engineering, and Operations; support complaint investigations, record completeness checks, and tracking to closure.

* Promptly escalate potential safety issues and time-sensitive events to Quality and Regulatory for evaluation and reporting decisions; prepare complaint and feedback trend summaries.

**Design Control Risk Management and Software Compliance Support**

* Maintain and organize design and development records, including design reviews, verification and validation evidence, traceability matrices, and design change documentation.

* Support maintenance of risk management records and links among identified hazards, risk controls, verification evidence, and post-market feedback using knowledge of ISO 14971.

* Support review and organization of software lifecycle records using knowledge of IEC 62304 requirements, including software requirements, verification, configuration and change management, and problem resolution.

**Quality System Support**

* Support internal and external audits by retrieving records and tracking assigned actions; assist with nonconformance and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) documentation.

* Compile quality metrics, identify record gaps, and follow up on assigned actions. Escalate compliance concerns and decisions requiring approval to the Quality Manager.

**Experience and Required Knowledge**

* 3-5 years of experience in medical device quality or related quality systems work, including experience with Class II medical devices.

* Practical experience with document control, training coordination, and electronic document or quality management systems.

* Working knowledge of FDA Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), 21 CFR Part 820, and ISO 13485 quality system requirements.

* Knowledge of medical device design control, ISO 14971 risk management, and IEC 62304 medical device software lifecycle requirements.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, biomedical engineering, life sciences, quality, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with CPAP or other respiratory therapy devices, connected hardware/software medical devices, or eQMS implementation.

* Experience supporting complaint handling, audits, CAPA, or software verification and validation documentation.

**Key Competencies and Work Environment**

Strong attention to detail, organization, communication, and follow-through. Ability to manage multiple assignments, handle confidential information, and collaborate across technical and customer-facing teams in a medical device development and commercial environment.

jobs.title: ECM, SF - Care Manager
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** Monday-Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm
  
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
The HealthRIGHT 360 ECM program is based in the Integrated Care Center Clinic, a federally qualified health center that provides primary care, behavioral health, addiction treatment, psychiatry, dental care, and more. We provide care to those most in need including those who are suffering from homelessness, mental illness, substance use, mental illness, and chronic medical conditions. We provide team-based care in an integrated care setting. We are looking for a mission driven service leader who works well in a team, has experience with managing and supporting members, champions quality improvement, leads change, and is excited to innovate.
  
  
The Care Manager will provide intensive, client-centered case management to support both patients in the ICC and across other HealthRIGHT 360 programs in San Francisco, in achieving stability, health, and self-sufficiency. The Case Manager I, under the Enhanced Care Management (ECM) program, is responsible for maintaining a caseload of members enrolled in a Managed Care Plan (MCP). This role focuses on delivering community-based case management services, linking clients to appropriate resources to address needs such as health benefits, physical and behavioral health care, substance use treatment, housing, employment, justice-involved issues, family services, and other social supports. In partnership with the San Francisco Health Plan and HealthRIGHT 360’s Integrated Care Clinic (ICC)—a brick-and-mortar primary care site located at 1563 Mission Street in San Francisco—the Care Manager I provides coordinated care to a diverse patient population. This includes collaboration with clinical and community providers to ensure comprehensive service delivery.
  
  
This is a field-based position requiring proactive outreach and engagement with members in the community, including visits to clients' homes, service provider sites, and other locations across San Francisco.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
**Client Care and Care Coordination Responsibilities:**  

* The Care Manager will be responsible for organizing patient care activities, sharing information with those involved as part of the multi-disciplinary care team, and implementing activities identified in the Managed Care Plan.
* Identifying eligible people from within State Prisons, County Jails, hospitals, and other locations for enrollment into ECM.
* Using multiple strategies for engagement, including direct communication with the member (and/or their advocates), such as in-person meetings where the member lives, seeking care or is accessible; mail, email, texts, and telephone; community and street-level outreach.
* Maintaining regular contact with all providers identified as part of the members’ care team, whose input is necessary for successful implementation of member goals and needs, including Justice Involved oversight.
* Ensuring care is continuous and integrated among all service providers and referring to and following up with primary care, physical and developmental health, mental health, SUD treatment, and necessary community-based and social services, including housing, as needed.
* Providing support to engage the member in their treatment, including coordination for medication review and/or reconciliation, scheduling appointments, providing appointment reminders, coordinating transportation, accompaniment to critical appointments, and identifying and helping to address other barriers to member engagement in treatment.
* Responsible for engaging with a multi- disciplinary care team to identify gaps in the member’s care and ensure appropriate input is obtained to effectively coordinate all primary, behavioral, developmental, oral health, Community Supports.
* Assist the client with intake by completing assessments as required by the MCP.
* Monitors client's progress toward achieving Care management treatment plan goals and provides treatment plan input.
* Assess the client’s Care Manager needs and completes all Releases of information.
* Connects the client to benefits, healthcare services, employment, housing, community resources, outpatient substance use services, and other benefits/resources available to the client.
* Coordinates communication and external service linkage including assisting with scheduling appointments, communicating with probation, scheduling child visits, communicating with Family and Children Services, obtaining all court minute orders, providing appointment reminders for therapy and psychiatrists.
* Collaborate with clients and their families to support reintegration into the community.

jobs.title: Patient Services Specialist
jobs.description:
**Be the first point of care—guiding patients through admission with accuracy, compassion, and confidence while ensuring every detail of their visit is handled seamlessly.**

At SimonMed Imaging, the patient experience starts long before an exam takes place. Our Patient Service Specialists play a critical role in facilitating the patient admission flow across our imaging centers. From greeting patients to verifying insurance and processing documentation, this role ensures each visit starts with clarity, efficiency, and care.

We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates with empathy, and takes pride in delivering exceptional service. If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, and being part of a collaborative healthcare team, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day.

### **What You Bring**

**A patient-first mindset:** You treat every interaction with empathy, respect, and genuine concern for patient needs.

**Strong communication and team-oriented approach:** You communicate clearly, listen actively, support patients and teams with professionalism and empathy, and contribute to smooth, collaborative front desk operations.

**Attention to detail:** You accurately collect, process, and maintain patient demographics, insurance information, medical histories, consent forms, and payments with accuracy and care.

**Adaptability and composure:** You stay calm under pressure in high-volume environments, manage competing priorities, and handle sensitive or challenging situations with professionalism.

**Reliability, accountability, and problem-solving:** You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, consistently arrive prepared and ready to support the team, contribute to a positive culture, and help resolve scheduling, billing, and patient flow issues while maintaining a positive patient experience.

### **What You'll Gain**

**Purpose-driven work:** Your role is essential to patient care, ensuring every individual is welcomed, supported, and guided through a smooth and compassionate access experience from the very start of their visit.

**A collaborative team environment:** Partner with clinical, operational, and support teams focused on delivering exceptional patient experiences.

**Growth opportunities:** Gain experience in healthcare operations, patient access, and medical administration within a growing organization.

### **You're a Strong Fit if You Have**

* 1+ years of customer service, patient access, medical office, or call center experience preferred

* Experience with scheduling, insurance verification, or healthcare registration processes preferred

* Strong computer and data entry skills

* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

* Experience working with EMR/PM systems preferred

* High school diploma or equivalent required

### **Benefits**

Your health, happiness and future matters!

At SimonMed Imaging, we offer:

* We believe in preventative care for everyone including our team – SimonMed provides free, whole-body scans to each member

* Competitive wages

* No nights/no calls/no weekends

* Cross training opportunities

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance

* 401(k) eligibility

* Pet Insurance

* Paid holidays

* PTO

* Sick Time

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Patient Experience
jobs.description:
**Hybrid Preferred**, *Palo Alto or San Francisco (2 days/week in office)*  
***Reports to:*** *VP Product, Patient Experience*  
***Job Type:*** *Full-time W2*

### **The Role**

Midi is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Patient Experience to own the digital experience that helps women build a long-term relationship with Midi. Our goal is to be a patient's healthcare home, supporting more of her care needs both in and outside of telehealth visits. This role will shape the journey from the first visit and onward: how patients stay engaged, return for follow-up care, and discover the other ways Midi can support them. You will set the roadmap and work with Clinical Operations, Lifecycle Marketing, Data, Engineering, Design, and more to ship experiences that are trusted, empathetic, and measurably improve patient engagement and retention.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Own the Patient Experience Roadmap:** Define the vision and roadmap for the web experience patients use across their care journey, from onboarding and visit preparation through follow-up care and long-term support. Set clear targets for engagement and retention, and prioritize the bets most likely to reach them.
* **Extend Care Beyond the Visit:** Identify and build the touchpoints that help patients get more of their care needs met with Midi, in and outside of telehealth visits, such as follow-up care, ongoing treatment support, and access to additional services.
* **Understand & Improve the Patient Journey:** Combine patient research, feedback, and funnel and cohort analysis to find where patients disengage or run into friction, then run experiments and ship improvements that build trust and keep patients coming back.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Serve as the product lead for patient experience, partnering closely with **Clinical Operations**, **Lifecycle Marketing**, **Data**, **Engineering**, and **Design**, and with other teams across Midi as needed. You will lead through influence, building shared goals and making tradeoffs clear across your cross-functional team.

### **Requirements**

* **Consumer Product Experience:** 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years building consumer-facing digital products and owning engagement or retention metric targets. You have a track record of delivering measurable outcomes in complex business areas.
* **Experimentation & Data Fluency:** Skilled in hypothesis-driven development, A/B testing, and funnel and cohort analysis. You work closely with data partners, are comfortable digging into the numbers yourself, and use results to guide product strategy.
* **Patient-Centered Design Sense:** A strong grasp of UX best practices and of how clarity, empathy, and ease of use shape trust and engagement in a healthcare experience. You can turn friction in a patient flow into a clear hypothesis and a testable solution.
* **Focus on Patient LTV:** A strong understanding of how onboarding, ongoing engagement, and lifecycle communication shape retention, repeat usage, and lifetime value. You are motivated by helping patients build a lasting relationship with Midi.
* **High-Agency Problem Solver:** An action-oriented, ownership mindset with the ability to break complex challenges into simple, scalable solutions in a fast-paced environment.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** A strong track record of leading cross-functional teams without direct authority across Clinical Operations, Lifecycle Marketing, Data, Engineering, and Design. You build alignment, balance competing priorities, and present clearly to stakeholders at all levels.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Healthcare or Healthtech Experience:** Prior experience in a healthcare or digital health environment with an understanding of how to balance patient engagement with privacy (HIPAA) and clinical compliance.
  

*This is a full-time W2 position. The base salary range is* ***160K-200K*** *and will depend on experience. Midi pays a competitive base salary, plus equity and benefits.*
