jobs.title: Compliance Program Manager — Regulatory Compliance
jobs.description:
Security - San Francisco

**About the team**

Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) builds compliance programs and provides assurance for OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We combine technical understanding with practical operations to reduce risk, support product and research teams, and produce reliable evidence of how our controls work.

**About the role**

As a Regulatory Compliance Program Manager, you will build and operate programs that turn regulatory requirements into clear responsibilities, effective processes, and evidence that can withstand external scrutiny.

Your work will focus on AI safety/security and content moderation, with privacy operations as an adjacent area. You will partner with Legal and the teams that build and operate our products to scope the work, maintain accurate control narratives, prepare regulatory responses, and lead external assessments for your assigned portfolio.

You should be comfortable owning delivery, explaining tradeoffs, and changing your recommendation when the evidence changes. Success means controls have accountable owners, evidence stays current, and teams can respond accurately without repeatedly rebuilding the same work. The initial portfolio and expectations will be agreed with the hiring manager.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead an agreed portfolio of AI safety/security and content-compliance work, including programs associated with the EU AI Act, DSA, OSA, and SB 53, with Legal and relevant experts confirming applicable requirements.
* Translate requirements into scoped programs, operating processes, control and evidence responsibilities, milestones, and clear escalation paths.
* Build and maintain accurate control narratives and traceable evidence for regulatory requests, reporting, audits, and assessments.
* Lead preparation and delivery for external compliance assessments, coordinate the responsible teams, and track gaps through verified resolution or an explicitly owned decision.
* Prioritize the work that materially improves compliance outcomes and reduces risk; explain what should proceed, change, or wait and why.
* Develop evidence-backed recommendations with Legal, Product, Security, Safety, Integrity, Privacy, and other functional teams. Obtain decisions from the authorized owners for legal interpretation, external representations, and risk acceptance.
* Improve operational workflows for content and privacy compliance while keeping implementation and operation of controls with the appropriate functional owners.
* Simplify and automate repeated administrative work, test the results, and verify that the improvement is adopted and produces accurate, reliable outputs.
* Learn the GRC security-control environment and participate in the team’s on-call rotation, with scope and expectations explained during the hiring process.
* Communicate clearly, surface uncertainty early, incorporate feedback, and develop the domain knowledge needed for the next priority.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have practical experience building and operating AI safety/security and content-moderation programs, and can explain your own decisions, contribution, and results.
* Have used agentic tooling to automate and improve to scaled processes
* Understand relevant technical concepts across model evaluation, training and release, safety controls, content moderation, and post-launch operations, and can explain where specialist input is needed.
* Have a strong understanding of relevant AI safety, content, and privacy requirements, including the EU AI Act, DSA, OSA, and SB 53, and experience translating them into operating processes and controls with domain experts and Legal.
* Have led regulatory responses and external compliance audits, and can distinguish supported claims from evidence gaps.
* Have delivered complex cross-functional programs, scoped practical first increments, and adapted priorities when constraints changed.
* Have improved or automated an operational workflow and verified its accuracy, usefulness, and ongoing ownership.
* Can maintain precise records, navigate technical/compliance documentation and contract language, follow through on commitments, and judge what to resolve directly or escalate.
* Communicate clearly in writing and conversation with technical teams, Legal, leadership, and external stakeholders; explain evidence, uncertainty, recommendations, and tradeoffs.
* Work constructively through disagreement, learn from feedback, and take responsibility for outcomes. Privacy program-management experience is a plus.

AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Program Manager, AV Safety Policy & Programs
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is building the safety capability for autonomous mobility. As Program Manager, AV Safety Policy & Programs, you'll own key parts of Lyft's AV Safety Management System (SMS) across all four pillars: Safety Policy, Safety Risk Management, Safety Assurance, and Safety Promotion. You'll also make sure the processes, documentation, and cross-functional machinery behind them work in practice.

This is a high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of safety policy, program design, and cross-functional process support. You'll author policy, run risk and review cadences, turn safety data into decisions, and keep the Safety Review Board (SRB) running. You'll work closely with AV partners, and you can speak credibly about AV safety with technical counterparts, senior leaders, and external partners.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Safety Policy:** Own Lyft's AV safety policy framework, safety procedures, and partner-facing governance documentation, including version control and periodic review cycles. Maintain governance charters, committee operating rhythms, and escalation protocols.
* **Safety Risk Management:** Run hazard identification and risk assessment for AV operations and new launches. Maintain the operational risk register and track mitigations to closure.
* **Safety Assurance:** Track safety performance indicators and trends, and surface emerging risks. Participate in incident and near-miss investigations and own corrective action (CAPA) tracking, so findings feed back into policy, operations, and partner work plans. Coordinate evidence and remediation for audits and certifications.
* **Safety Promotion:** Drive safety communications, lessons-learned documentation, and training readiness.
* **Safety Review Board:** Run the SRB cadence, including agendas, materials, decision records, and follow-through on action items.
* **Partner Engagement:** Contribute to the standards and assessment frameworks Lyft uses with AV partners, and support partners' safety assurance and risk management activities.
* **Program Execution:** Drive AV safety programs with safety leaders, including partners across EHS, Operations, Engineering, Legal, and others from inception through go-live. This includes safety readiness for new market launches and partner integrations.

**Experience:**
---------------

* 4+ years supporting or managing safety management programs in a safety-critical transportation industry (AV, aviation, rail, automotive, trucking, or equivalent)
* Working knowledge of SMS principles and how they apply to AV operations
* Hands-on experience with risk assessment, incident follow-up, and corrective action tracking
* Strong technical writing, including policy, procedures, and partner- or regulator-facing materials
* Comfort with safety data, including tracking indicators, spotting trends, and presenting findings to technical and senior audiences
* Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder programs without direct authority
* Bachelor's degree in safety, engineering, policy, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* **Nice to Have**
  + Familiarity with AV safety frameworks (e.g., AVSC best practices) and US AV reporting requirements
  + Experience supporting robotaxi, ridehail, or fleet operations
  + Experience operating in a matrixed, partner-dependent environment where safety policy must be implemented through influence rather than direct control
  + Exposure to multi-market or international safety operations

**Benefits:**
-------------

* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, Energy Storage
jobs.description:
**About Redwood Materials**

**Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.**

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, Energy Storage is a career-level individual contributor role that owns program management across all commodities supporting the Energy Storage business. The role builds and maintains the integrated supply chain schedule across commodity owners, suppliers, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Finance, tracks supplier milestones and risks, and drives material readiness for new product introduction builds and production ramp. The role works independently and is reviewed at critical points. This is a fully on-site role in our San Francisco R&D space, with approximately 10% international travel to supplier sites.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead the integrated supply chain program plan across all Energy Storage commodities (for example, electronics PCBAs, mechanical components, energy equipment, solar panels, and harnesses), tracking milestones, dependencies, and resources across suppliers and internal teams
* Serve as the liaison between Supply Chain commodity teams and Programs, Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, and leadership, communicating program status, key milestones, and risks
* Identify supply and schedule risks early, and devise and drive mitigation plans with commodity owners and suppliers
* Coordinate supplier readiness for new product introduction builds and production ramp, including capacity, qualification, and delivery plans
* Track supply chain program metrics (cost, lead time, delivery performance, inventory) across commodities and report results to leadership
* Resolve cross-functional issues and escalations that affect program schedule, cost, or quality
* Develop and improve program management tools, templates, and processes for supply chain programs

**Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of program management, supply chain, or sourcing experience (3+ years with a Master's degree), ideally in energy storage, battery, EV, or electronics manufacturing
* Working knowledge of new product introduction, production ramp, and supply chain operations across electronic, mechanical, and electromechanical commodities
* Experience building and managing integrated schedules, milestone trackers, and risk registers across multiple stakeholders and commodity teams
* Ability to analyze supply chain data (cost, lead time, delivery, inventory) to identify trends and risks
* Ability to communicate program status and risks clearly, in writing and verbally, to cross-functional partners and leadership
* Ability to travel internationally to supplier sites approximately 10% of the time

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

  

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Expansion
jobs.description:
**About Brightidea**
--------------------

Brightidea is the enterprise innovation management platform behind programs at Merck, J&J, AWS, Cytiva, and hundreds of other global organizations. We've been at this for 26 years, we're profitable, which means small surface area, short decision paths, and a lot of leverage per person.

**About the role**
------------------

You own a book of large, under-penetrated Fortune 1000 accounts where Brightidea holds a beachhead — a single department, a single program, a fraction of what the organization could be running. Your job is to crack those accounts open: build executive sponsorship from a small footprint, multi-thread across a complex organization, and grow toward enterprise-wide adoption while protecting what's already in place.

This is a hunter-builder seat, not a caretaker seat. It carries a real number and real accountability.

We've written it deliberately to screen out the standard enterprise SaaS account manager. If your value is relationship maintenance, QBR cadence, and renewal paperwork, this seat won't suit you and you won't enjoy it.

**Why this isn't a traditional Account Manager role**
-----------------------------------------------------

* **You have to build, not just sell.** Our customers are innovation leaders at Merck, J&J, AWS, Cytiva and their peers, and many of them are now building with AI themselves. You'll sit across from people who can prototype, and you need to prototype alongside them — mock a workflow, model a use case, turn platform usage data into a commercial case without waiting on an engineer or an analyst.
* **You have to hold the harder conversation.** A customer who can build their own tooling will ask why they need a platform at all. Answering that credibly means understanding both what we do and what is genuinely hard to replicate. A polished commercial pitch won't survive that conversation.
* **You'll find your own buyers.** Roughly a third of your book is net-new footprint inside existing logos — new business units, new use cases, new executive sponsors who have never heard of us. Nobody hands you that pipeline.
* **The business is changing underneath the role.** Brightidea is evolving how it engages large enterprises, and this seat sits at the front of that. If ambiguity bothers you, this is the wrong company right now. If you want a role where the shape of the work is still being decided, this is a good moment to arrive.
* **You carry a number and own the outcome.** Blended retention plus growth, reviewed monthly with your manager and quarterly with the executive team. The targets are in this document because we'd rather you know them before you apply.

**The bar: AI fluency is non-negotiable**
-----------------------------------------

This is a hard gate, not a preference. We won't make an offer to a strong commercial candidate who isn't genuinely AI-fluent, regardless of track record. We define it concretely:

* **You've built things.** Automations, agents, scripts, internal tools, integrations — something beyond prompting a chatbot. You should be able to walk us through what you built, why, and what broke.
* **AI is in your daily workflow, not your toolkit.** Account research, org mapping, territory planning, first-draft outreach, data analysis. We'll ask how you actually work, and we'll be able to tell.
* **You can produce a working artifact in front of a customer.** A mock, a prototype, a data cut, a solution sketch — fast enough to be useful in the meeting rather than in the follow-up.
* **You can reason about where AI helps and where it doesn't,** including the limits. We need someone who can tell a customer honestly that one thing is easy to build and another isn't.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Treat each account as a mini-territory: build and execute a penetration plan that moves it from beachhead toward enterprise-wide adoption
* Build executive sponsorship out from a single champion or department, multi-threading across large, political organizations where your original contact may not be your path to the budget
* Own renewal negotiation and close, including price increases and multi-year terms against enterprise procurement
* Source net-new buyers inside existing logos — new business units, adjacent use cases, executives who have never engaged with us
* Convert platform adoption and usage data into commercial cases; program results are your ammunition, and you should be able to pull and shape that data yourself
* Position Brightidea credibly against build-it-yourself alternatives, including customers prototyping with AI
* Forecast accurately and keep a clean cadence across ~25 accounts, concentrating effort where the runway is greatest

  

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

We care about the combination of commercial instinct and technical fluency, not the label on your last job. Three profiles fit:

* **Enterprise expansion** — you've carried a number expanding inside large, complex accounts, in an enterprise motion rather than SMB velocity. You've grown a logo from one business unit to enterprise-wide, or materially grown ARR inside a named account.
* **Consultant / solution architect** — you've delivered into large enterprises from a consulting or professional services background, with genuine commercial exposure: scoping, pricing, expanding engagements. You're comfortable being the person in the room who designs the answer.
* **Founder / operator** — you've built and sold something, carried revenue responsibility end to end, built your own tooling, and are comfortable with the ambiguity of an evolving business.

**Required across all three:**

* Experience navigating enterprise procurement, renewal negotiation, price increases, and multi-year terms
* Multi-threading in complex organizations, where you've built sponsorship starting from one contact and no budget
* A territory-development mindset with a concrete approach to whitespace

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About AppLovin**

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a smart, hardworking Business Operations Analyst to provide technical and operational support to our Business Operations (BizOps) team and the systems supporting our mobile-advertising business.

A central part of this role is helping other BizOps analysts deliver reliable projects. You will review their code, debug existing workflows, investigate product issues, and translate business problems into actionable requests for Engineering and Operations. You will also write and maintain your own workflow code and analyze product features and experiments.

You will serve as a practical link between business and technical teams. We're looking for someone who learns quickly, investigates problems independently, exercises good judgment, and follows issues through to resolution.

AI-assisted development is a regular part of how our team works. You should be effective at using these tools and reviewing the code they produce, with the technical understanding to identify mistakes, challenge assumptions, and guide work toward reliable results.

### **Responsibilities**

* Support projects led by other BizOps analysts, helping clarify requirements, review technical approaches, and resolve implementation problems.
* Debug issues in existing workflow code, integrations, and data processes. Investigate root causes and implement or coordinate fixes.
* Review BizOps pull requests, including substantial AI-generated changes, for correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with business requirements. Provide actionable feedback and verify that concerns are addressed.
* Write and maintain Python code, SQL workflows, integrations, and automations supporting the team's work.
* Investigate product bugs, distinguish expected behavior from defects, and gather evidence through code, logs, data, and reproducible examples.
* Write clear tickets for Engineering and Operations that explain the problem, business impact, supporting evidence, and expected outcome. Follow up on dependencies and verify resolutions.
* Manage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services supporting BizOps workflows, including service accounts, permissions, secrets, configuration, and deployments.
* Support Salesforce workflows and integrations, including programming against its application programming interfaces (APIs).
* Analyze product features, experiments, and operational and advertising data. Apply appropriate statistical methods, interpret results accurately, and explain limitations.
* Investigate discrepancies across internal systems and partner platforms.
* Prioritize competing requests and communicate findings, decisions, blockers, and next steps through concise Slack messages, tickets, and documentation.

### **Qualifications**

* At least two years of relevant professional experience in business operations, technical operations, analytics, software development, or a related field.
* Demonstrated technical ability through a bachelor's degree in a field such as engineering, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or physics, or through substantial technical work, research, or projects.
* Strong problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems, connect information across sources, and work through ambiguous problems.
* A strong work ethic and sense of ownership: you take initiative, persist through difficult problems, and follow work through to completion.
* Good judgment about data quality, system changes, permissions, and operational risk. You recognize which problems you can resolve independently and when additional expertise or review is needed.
* Effective use of AI coding and workflow tools to develop, review, and maintain substantial volumes of code. You can evaluate generated work, identify mistakes, and steer it toward the intended outcome.
* Practical experience with Python, SQL, Git, pull-request workflows, and APIs, including investigating and debugging existing code.
* Hands-on experience managing GCP services and workflows, including permissions, credentials, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Experience applying statistical analysis and data science techniques, including selecting appropriate methods, interpreting results accurately, and explaining limitations.
* Experience in advertising technology, with a working understanding of areas such as campaign delivery, attribution, measurement, mediation, monetization, or the iOS and Android ecosystems.
* Clear, concise written communication. You can explain technical issues in business terms, document reproducible problems, and write requirements and tickets that others can act on.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting internal tools, reviewing other people's code, or coordinating technical work across business, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Experience with Salesforce administration, reporting, permission models, or integrations.
* Experience maintaining production automations, data pipelines, or shared internal applications.
* Familiarity with least-privilege access and sensitive data handling.

### **What Success Looks Like**

BizOps analysts can rely on you to investigate technical problems, review their work thoughtfully, and help their projects move forward. Engineering and Operations receive clear, actionable req

**About NinjaTech**
===================

NinjaTech builds SuperNinja Enterprise, an agent platform that enterprises deploy inside their own cloud. Our agents run 24/7, carry persistent context across long tasks, and execute multi-step work end to end. We are partnered with and backed by Infosys, a strategic investor and channel partner helping us bring SuperNinja to enterprise customers at scale.

**The role**
============

We are hiring our first Partner Enablement Manager to own enablement for the Infosys partnership. Infosys is both an investor and a strategic go-to-market partner, so this role is foundational: you will build the enablement engine that lets Infosys's sales and services teams confidently position, sell, deploy, and support SuperNinja. You turn our product, positioning, and proof points into partner-ready assets, training, and certification, and you make sure the field can execute without us in the room.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Own the end-to-end Infosys enablement program: onboarding, training, certification, and ongoing readiness for partner sales, solution, and delivery teams.
* Build and maintain partner-facing collateral: pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling, demo scripts, ROI narratives, and implementation playbooks.
* Design and run enablement sessions (live and on-demand) and stand up a certification path so Infosys teams can qualify and progress opportunities independently.
* Operate the "second line / first line" model: equip Infosys to be first line with their customers while we back them as second line, and close the loop on what the field needs.
* Partner with Product, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to keep enablement current as the product and roadmap evolve.
* Stand up and own the partner portal / knowledge base and keep it the single source of truth.
* Define and track enablement KPIs: partner certification rates, pipeline influenced, deal velocity, and win rates on partner-sourced opportunities.
* Run joint GTM motions with Infosys (co-selling, events, webinars) and feed field learnings back into positioning.

**What you'll bring**
=====================

* 5+ years in partner/channel enablement, sales enablement, or solutions consulting, ideally in enterprise B2B software, AI, or cloud.
* Proven track record building enablement programs for a systems integrator, consultancy, or large channel partner.
* Strong writer and communicator: you can turn technical depth into crisp, field-ready messaging.
* Comfort with technical, platform-level products (AI/agents, cloud deployment, enterprise security) and the ability to learn fast.
* A builder's mindset: you are the first hire in this function and will define how it operates.

**Success looks like**
======================

We are seeking an experienced Operations Manager to serve as the operational and managerial backbone of our growing online business. This role turns vision into action through systems, team leadership, project oversight, and operational strategy. A key part of this role is managing a team of 13. This includes a sales team, health coaches, and other team members. Most of the systems and processes are in place, so the biggest focus is the team.

Elevate Health Naturally is a root-cause health coaching company in the category of **Foundational Medicine**, a systems-based approach that addresses cellular dysfunction in the correct sequence before any detox, hormone, or gut protocol can succeed. We serve women (and men as standalone clients) who know something is wrong, have tried supplements and perhaps seen a functional medicine doctor, got some results, but haven't found anything that lasts, and are ready for a better solution that actually solves the root cause.

Our mission is to empower women to understand their bodies, trust the process of healing, and build lasting health, not just for themselves, but in a ripple effect that heals their husbands, their children, and the generations that follow. We currently have a team of 13, and we are in a growth phase, expanding programs, improving operations, and building long-term sustainability.

* Create, update, and maintain SOPs for every core process as the business grows
* Manage the project management system and keep workflows current
* Own the tech stack: keep tools and automations working, and recommend upgrades when something no longer fits.

**Project Management**

* Turn strategic initiatives into clear, actionable project plans
* Break down projects into tasks, milestones, and timelines

* Coordinate team tasks and ensure deadlines are met

* Review metrics from marketing, sales, retention, and operations to identify trends
* Support data-driven decisions with clear insights and recommendations
* Monitor budgets, timelines, and resource allocation

* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Ability to lead team members and maintain accountability
* Detail-oriented with strong follow-through
* Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision

**Time Commitment:**

**Your Role**

You are an experienced project manager who drives complex work across teams and organizations you don’t control. You plan carefully, communicate clearly with engineers and executives alike, and treat documentation and tracking as core infrastructure, not an afterthought.

In this role, you’ll work closely with engineering, privacy, and data teams at Dandelion and at our health system partners. You will: (i) oversee the execution of data extraction and de-identification across our health system partners, keeping deliveries on time, and (ii) serve as the primary point of contact for those partners, managing day-to-day project operations and communication.

You’ve led large, multi-stakeholder projects and know how to move work forward without direct authority. You spot problems early, map out options before they’re needed, and document your learnings. You understand data well enough to scope extractions, catch quality issues, and work within privacy and compliance constraints.

You will report directly to the Chief Network Officer.

* Develop and execute comprehensive data extraction roadmaps across multiple health systems, including building business cases for net-new data sources and adjusting schedules, as needed, to ensure timely completion.
* Build strong, long-lasting relationships with our health system partners across functional areas and serve as the operations main point of contact for the Dandelion partnership.
* Work autonomously, driving and influencing cross functional internal and external data and engineering teams.

**Hy-Tek Intralogistics**

**Job Description**

**Job Title:** Senior Project Manager

**Department:** Project Management

**Supervisor:** Manager, Project Management

**Job Purpose:**

Working in partnership with key internal, external, and executive stakeholders, this position oversees high-priority projects, which often require considerable resources and complex hardware and software integrations. The position interfaces with all areas affected by the project, including end users, distributors, and vendors; it also ensures adherence to quality standards and reviews project deliverables.

* Act as the point person for client communications during implementation.

* Utilize change management in accordance with established business processes.
* Develops resource plans to manage resources effectively. Maintain project budgets and a detailed project cost variance report.
* Manages the project to identify, assess and prioritize issues and risks to minimize, monitor, and control the probability and/or impact of negative events or to maximize the realization of positive events.
* Build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions.
* Interpret and apply understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions. Track invoice dates and proactively communicate changes/updates.
* Ascertain complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* Plan and prioritize work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.
* Handle conflict situations effectively to minimize recourse.
* Develop and deliver communications with cross-functional and diverse teams effectively to meet project objectives to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
* Organize and conduct weekly status meetings along with generating weekly status reports.
* Manage legal aspects of the project, with support of legal team, including subcontractor agreements, permit applications, and site inspections.
* Oversee daily activities of subcontractors during contract implementation. Ensure contractors follow industry standards for workmanship.
* Coordinate delivery and implementation of all projects close out documents.
* Provides mentorship and guidance to Project Manager levels I and II.
* Responsible for all other duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Preferred:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, management preferred, or equivalent related experience required
* 7+ Years’ experience in the Material Handling Industry or equivalent is preferred.
* Advanced knowledge of Conveyor, Racking, Storage Systems and Advancing Technologies (Robotics, Goods to Person Systems etc.)
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred.
* Experience in planning, managing, and executing basic, medium, and complex material handling projects is preferred.
* OSHA-10 Certification is preferred.
* Excellent problem solving, judgment making, and organizational skills.
* Advanced experience in planning, managing, and executing basic, medium, and complex material handling projects is preferred.
* Ability to work without direct supervision with a high degree of responsibility.
* Well-developed verbal/interpersonal skills with strong organizational, problem solving and time management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and comfortably in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent organization, priority setting, and project management skills with experience managing multiple projects concurrently.
* Ability to communicate with internal team members and drive changes or decisions necessary for project implementation.
* Ability to understand mechanical and electrical drawings with assistance from engineering.
* Excellent understanding and adherence to change management business processes.
* AutoCAD viewer & Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Teams, SharePoint) experience preferred.
* Experience with installation and/or integration of systems is preferred.
* Extensive industry knowledge related to supply chain, logistics, material handling systems, and software such as WMS, WCS, ERP, etc. is preferred.
* Hands-on mechanical aptitude preferred.

**Working Conditions:**

* Travel generally requires about 50% of your time but could be higher depending on project demands.
* Occasional weekend and night required as project deems necessary
* Working in office, warehouse, and manufacturing facilities.
* Working in a stationary position for an extended period.
* Moving or traversing for an extended period.
* Occasional ascending and descending scaffolding and/or mezzanines.
* Operating computers for an extended period.
* Possible exposure to noise levels exceeding recommended DBA levels.
* Occasional movement and positioning of objects weighing up to 75 pounds.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

**Position Summary**

As a Senior Project Manager within the Enterprise PMO, you will lead high-priority strategic and enterprise initiatives that advance Valeris business objectives, operating model maturity, and scalable growth. You will provide end-to-end leadership across complex, cross-functional efforts, bringing structure to ambiguity and aligning executive sponsors, functional leaders, and delivery teams around clear outcomes, decisions, and accountability.

This highly visible role requires exceptional executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across functions without direct authority. The successful candidate will establish strong governance, manage interdependencies and organizational change, and translate strategy into executable plans that deliver measurable business value.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead complex, enterprise-wide strategic initiatives from initiation through implementation, adoption, and transition to sustained ownership.
* Partner with executive sponsors and functional leaders to define the business problem, strategic outcomes, scope, success measures, and decision rights for each initiative.
* Develop and execute integrated project plans that include workstreams, milestones, critical path dependencies, resource requirements, financial considerations, and change impacts.
* Establish and lead program governance, including executive steering committees, sponsor reviews, decision forums, workstream cadences, and escalation pathways.
* Create alignment across Operations, Technology, Finance, Commercial, Product, People, and other business functions to advance enterprise priorities.
* Drive accountability for deliverables, commitments, decisions, and interdependencies; surface obstacles early and maintain momentum across competing priorities.
* Proactively identify and manage risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and organizational readiness requirements, with clear mitigation and recovery plans.
* Manage scope and change through disciplined assessment of impacts to strategic outcomes, timeline, investment, resources, operating model, and benefits realization.
* Prepare and deliver concise executive-level status reports, dashboards, recommendations, and decision materials that enable timely, informed action.
* Monitor initiative health, milestones, resource utilization, budget performance, key performance indicators, and expected business benefits; recommend corrective action as needed.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Human Evaluations (Recommendations)
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

**Job Description**

Great recommendations are how members find something worth their time. We are looking for an experienced Human Evaluations Program Manager to help us measure and improve the quality of recommendations across the Netflix homepage and discovery experience. You will work alongside Product Management and ML teams to build the human evaluation programs that tell us whether recommendations are working for members, and where they are not.

**About the Role**

Netflix is building toward more relevant, more varied, and more trustworthy recommendations, and thoughtful, high-quality evaluation is essential to making sure we are moving in the right direction. Join a team creating the frameworks, tools, and workflows that ensure human judgment is applied with consistency, clarity, and care, whether we are evaluating relevance, repetition, diversity, or whether a recommendation simply makes sense to the member.

You will not only shape how human evaluations of our recommendations are designed, but also own the day-to-day execution. From scoping and planning to vendor management, rater onboarding, and calibration, you will be accountable for driving delivery from start to finish. Just as critically, you will act as a thought partner to Product Management, helping translate recommendation strategy into evaluation designs and building a shared language around recommendation quality across teams.

**The Opportunity**

In this role, you will partner across product, research, data science, UX, and engineering to develop rubrics, frameworks, and workflows that enable rigorous, scalable human evaluation of recommendations. Beyond shaping the "what" and "how," you will also lead the "when" and "done." You will keep evaluation projects on track, ensuring consistent execution, timely delivery, efficient use of vendor capacity, and high rater alignment. If you are excited to bring structure to ambiguity and influence what members see when they open Netflix, while being accountable for tangible delivery, this is your chance to create meaningful impact from day one.

**The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of structure and flexibility. You know how to create evaluation frameworks that are rigorous and scalable, and you are also a driver who gets them out the door. You are skilled at translating product strategy into evaluation workflows, defining milestones, managing vendors, and delivering consistent results in a dynamic environment. You can steer teams across functions, keep timelines on track, and ensure rater quality without micromanaging. You are curious about how personalization works and can build credibility with PMs, data scientists, and ML engineers. You have working fluency in film and TV content and can quickly scan a set of titles to tell whether they belong together. You thrive in spaces where there is no roadmap, and you take pride in making things real, not just possible.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end execution of human evaluation and data operations initiatives, from intake and scoping to delivery
* Partner with Product Management to translate recommendation strategy and roadmap priorities into evaluation designs, success metrics, and timelines
* Manage human annotation vendors, including capacity planning, SLAs, quality performance, and escalations

* Develop clear, scalable guidelines and scoring rubrics to ensure consistent rater judgment, including for subjective, taste-based questions
* Oversee rater onboarding, calibration, and QA workflows
* Pilot and refine evaluation tasks to improve clarity, inter-rater reliability, and feedback quality
* Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks and blockers
Act as the connective tissue across product, ML, data science, and vendor partners to ensure alignment and effective execution of evaluations at scale  

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience working in human evaluations, data collection, labeling, or annotation operations in ML environments
* Track record of implementing process improvements or quality control systems for data collection needs
* Prior experience managing human annotation vendors, raters, or data labeling teams, including vendor performance and cost management
* Experience improving operational efficiency of annotation programs (throughput, turnaround, cost)
* Strong understanding of evaluation design, including guidelines, rubrics, and scoring protocols
* Working fluency in film and TV content, including genres, formats, and talent
* Proven ability in end-to-end management of complex, cross-functional programs, demonstrating strong Program Management skills and clear accountability for successful delivery
* Experience with human labeling platforms
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to synthesize feedback into clear recommendations and process improvements
* Familiarity with how rater subjectivity and bias affect taste-based judgments, and how to account for them in evaluation design
Strong organizational skills and executional focus; ability to track details while seeing the bigger picture  

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with personalization, recommender systems, search, or ranking evaluation
* Familiarity with how offline human evaluation complements online experimentation (A/B tests) and engagement metrics
* Experience evaluating at the list or page level, not only the individual item level
* Experience partnering with Product Managers and Dat

**Job Description**

**Job Title:** Senior Project Manager

**Department:** Project Management

**Supervisor:** Manager, Project Management

**Job Purpose:**

Working in partnership with key internal, external, and executive stakeholders, this position oversees high-priority projects, which often require considerable resources and complex hardware and software integrations. The position interfaces with all areas affected by the project, including end users, distributors, and vendors; it also ensures adherence to quality standards and reviews project deliverables.

* Organize and conduct weekly status meetings along with generating weekly status reports.
* Manage legal aspects of the project, with support of legal team, including subcontractor agreements, permit applications, and site inspections.
* Oversee daily activities of subcontractors during contract implementation. Ensure contractors follow industry standards for workmanship.
* Coordinate delivery and implementation of all projects close out documents.

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred.
* Experience in planning, managing, and executing basic, medium, and complex material handling projects is preferred.

* Excellent problem solving, judgment making, and organizational skills.
* Advanced experience in planning, managing, and executing basic, medium, and complex material handling projects is preferred.
* Ability to work without direct supervision with a high degree of responsibility.
* Well-developed verbal/interpersonal skills with strong organizational, problem solving and time management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and comfortably in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent organization, priority setting, and project management skills with experience managing multiple projects concurrently.
* Ability to communicate with internal team members and drive changes or decisions necessary for project implementation.
* Ability to understand mechanical and electrical drawings with assistance from engineering.
* Excellent understanding and adherence to change management business processes.
* AutoCAD viewer & Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Teams, SharePoint) experience preferred.
* Experience with installation and/or integration of systems is preferred.
* Extensive industry knowledge related to supply chain, logistics, material handling systems, and software such as WMS, WCS, ERP, etc. is preferred.
* Hands-on mechanical aptitude preferred.

**Working Conditions:**

This role sits at the intersection of compliance, machine learning, and AI tooling: you will use modern intelligence tools, including Claude and other LLM-based agents, to automate significant portions of oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — turning a traditionally manual, documentation-heavy function into a scalable, defensible program. You will partner with Machine Learning, Engineering and BSA/AML Policy Teams to provide end-to-end technical oversight, effective challenge and ongoing monitoring throughout the model development lifecycle.

### **You Will**

* **Build with Modern AI Tools:** Use AI agents (Claude and similar LLM-based tools) to build automation that scales oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — including drafting requirements, exam-ready documentation, data quality monitoring and ongoing model performance reporting.
* Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints so that automated outputs remain defensible to regulators and independent monitors.
* Establish and maintain model and data governance frameworks aligned with SR 11-7, SR 26-2, and OCC 2011-12 so engineering teams can ship defensible models at pace. Provide effective challenge throughout the model development lifecycle and partner with the BSA/AML Policy Team and CAX stakeholders to ensure documentation is exam-ready.
* **Lead Ongoing Monitoring:** Lead the design and development of real-time dashboards to monitor model health, including input data monitoring and ongoing model performance.
* Set standards for threshold tuning and ongoing Below the Line (BTL) testing controls.
* Establish frameworks and triggers for identifying when model performance is degrading and requires tuning or deprecation. Partner during subsequent tuning exercises and ensure changes are within risk appetite and documented defensibly.
* **Provide End-to-End Oversight of Model Development:** Oversee Transaction Monitoring models, including heuristic and rules-based detection logic, threshold settings (below the line testing), and the data pipelines that feed alerts.
* Oversee blockchain analytics and screening tools (TRM, Chainalysis), with attention to typology coverage, alert quality, and integration with downstream investigations.
* Oversee Sanctions Screening models (LexisNexis), including list management, fuzzy-match tuning, and false-positive reduction.
* Oversee Customer Risk Scoring models, including segmentation logic, periodic recalibration, and effective challenge of risk drivers.
* Oversee the design and validation of AI-driven case resolution — LLM-based and ML-based models that triage, enrich, or disposition alerts — ensuring decisions are explainable, auditable, and defensible to regulators.

### **You Have**

* 7+ years of experience in compliance technology at regulated financial institutions, or as a consultant working with FIs.
* Hands-on experience building with modern AI tools — including Claude, GPT, or comparable LLM-based agents — and a track record of using them to automate work in production. This includes prompt engineering, designing agentic workflows, and integrating AI into operational processes.
* Experience with both Machine Learning and Heuristic models across Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, and Customer Risk Scoring.
* Experience with input data quality monitoring.
* Experience with model performance monitoring.
* Experience conducting AML model validations aligned with SR 11-7 and OCC 2011-12.
* Experience responding to examinations and consent orders, and working with regulators and independent monitors.
* Experience with virtual currencies, including the unique transaction monitoring and sanctions screening considerations they present.
* Familiarity with blockchain analytics and screening tools such as Chainalysis and TRM Labs.
* A track record of driving cross-functional initiatives.
* A working understanding of regulated financial services and corresponding compliance obligations.
* Familiarity with statistical concepts related to machine learning
Expertise in data analytics and visualization

#### **Description**

Rankings.io is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and client-focused Video Account Manager to join our growing Video Department.

In this role, you'll serve as a key point of contact for clients, ensuring a seamless experience from onboarding through content production, approvals, publishing, and ongoing account management. You'll work closely with our internal video production, creative, and advertising teams to keep projects moving, deadlines on track, and clients informed every step of the way.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates with confidence, and doesn't wait to be told what needs to happen next. You should be comfortable managing multiple client accounts, juggling competing priorities, and following through until the job is done.

#### **Responsibilities**

**Client Onboarding & Account Setup**

* Own the client onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and professional experience from day one.
* Coordinate welcome calls, account connection meetings, and onboarding follow-ups.
* Communicate onboarding requirements, next steps, and outstanding action items to clients.
* Set up and maintain client accounts, project boards, and communication channels in ClickUp and Slack.
* Coordinate account connections, securely manage client-provided credentials, and prepare standardized AI prompt documents.
* Ensure all onboarding requirements are completed before video content is ready for publication.

**Video Content Coordination & Approvals**

* Serve as the primary liaison between clients and internal teams throughout the video content review and approval process.
* Notify clients when videos are ready for review and ensure they have access to the appropriate platforms.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding feedback, revisions, and approvals to prevent production delays.
* Coordinate with internal teams to initiate content publishing once approvals are received.
* Keep clients informed of publishing timelines and confirm when their content goes live.

**Paid Advertising Coordination**

* Facilitate client review and approval of video advertisements and lead generation forms.
* Track outstanding approvals and follow up to keep advertising campaigns on schedule.
* Communicate campaign launch updates and coordinate post-launch check-in calls.
* Partner with internal advertising teams to ensure client requests, feedback, and next steps are clearly communicated.

**Ongoing Client Account Management**

* Manage day-to-day client communications through Slack, email, and scheduled meetings.
* Build strong client relationships through responsiveness, professionalism, and consistent follow-through.
* Prepare client meeting notes, document action items, and communicate important updates to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate project timelines, client deliverables, upcoming shoot dates, and account information in ClickUp.
* Proactively identify potential delays, outstanding client needs, and opportunities to improve the client experience.
* Coordinate across departments to ensure client expectations are understood and deliverables remain on track.

**Account Status & Offboarding**

* Maintain accurate client account statuses, including onboarding, active, offboarding, and inactive accounts.
* Coordinate client offboarding requests and communicate necessary next steps to internal teams.

* Experience in account management, client success, project coordination, or a similar client-facing role.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence communicating directly with clients.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Ability to follow up consistently, manage competing priorities, and keep projects moving without constant oversight.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate client records and project documentation.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with multiple internal stakeholders.
* Experience with project management platforms such as Monday, Asana, ClickUp, or similar tools.
* Proficiency with Slack, email, and virtual meeting platforms.

#### **Nice to Have**

* Experience working at a digital marketing agency, video production company, or creative agency.

* Exposure to paid digital advertising campaigns and lead generation.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Familiarity with the legal marketing industry.

#### **Benefits**

* Fully Remote
* Unlimited PTO
* $100 Wellness Reimbursement Program
* Quarterly training stipend for Professional Development
* 401(k) with 3% Employer match (Safe Harbor)
* 100% Employer-Paid Health Insurance (For Employee)

#### **What to Expect in the Interview Process**

* **Resume Review**: Applications and resumes are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team.
* **One Way Interview:** Selected candidates will receive a link to answer a short set of questions by video. Please plan to record your responses in your typical work-from-home environment, ensuring it is well-lit and free of distractions.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About HappyRobot  
  
HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

The Role  
  
As a Customer Success Manager, you will own the post-sale relationship with a portfolio of large, enterprise customers. You will make sure each customer sees real, measurable value from their AI workforce, and then help them expand it to new workflows, teams, and regions. You will work side by side with our forward-deployed engineers, deployment strategists, and account executives, and you will be the voice of the customer inside HappyRobot.  
This is a strategic role, not a support role. Our customers are adopting a new kind of technology, and you will guide them from first deployment to a fully scaled AI operation. We are especially interested in candidates with a logistics background who can earn the trust of large, complex organizations and speak the language of their operations teams.  
  
What You Will Do

* Own a portfolio of large enterprise accounts and act as the primary day-to-day and executive-level contact.
* Drive adoption and time-to-value by defining success metrics with each customer, such as resolution time, load coverage, calls automated, and cost savings.
* Run regular business reviews that translate performance data into clear business outcomes and next steps.
* Identify and lead expansion opportunities into new use cases, business units, and geographies, partnering closely with Sales.
* Partner with forward-deployed engineers and deployment strategists to scope, launch, and iterate on new workflows.
* Monitor account health, anticipate risk, and lead renewals with a clear view of value delivered.
* Capture customer feedback and turn it into actionable input for Product and Engineering.
* Build repeatable playbooks, onboarding materials, and best practices as the Customer Success function scales.

What You Bring

* 4 to 7 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS or technology company, with experience managing enterprise accounts.
* **Preferred:** Hands-on logistics, freight, or supply chain experience (for example at a freight broker, 3PL, carrier, shipper, or logistics technology company), ideally managing large, multi-stakeholder accounts.
* A track record of driving adoption, retention, and expansion, with comfort owning renewal and growth targets.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate with both operators on the floor and C-level stakeholders.
* Comfort with data. You can read usage and performance metrics, build a clear narrative around them, and recommend next steps.
* Technical curiosity. You do not need to code, but you should be comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, workflows, and AI concepts with customers and engineers.
* A bias for ownership and speed, with the ability to thrive in ambiguity at a fast-growing startup.

Nice to Have

* Experience with AI, automation, or voice products.
* Familiarity with TMS, WMS, or CRM systems.
* Spanish, Portuguese, or another language, given our LatAm and international customer base.
* Prior experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup.

Why Join Us

* Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
* Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital, and Eurazeo.
* Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
* Comprehensive benefits including healthcare, dental, and vision coverage.
* Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles  
  
**Extreme Ownership**  
We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting. If something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it is not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We do not wait for someone else to solve it. We lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

**Craftsmanship**  
Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping outcomes by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build, even when nobody is watching.

**We are “majos”**  
Be friendly and have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine and honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

**Urgency with Focus**  
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We are running a high-speed marathon, not a sprint with no strategy.

**Talent Density and Meritocracy**  
Hire only people who can raise the average; exceptional performance is the passing grade. Ability trumps seniority. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure.

**First-Principles Thinking**  
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, and rebuild the solution from scratch. We do not copy-paste solutions.

Compensation Range: $120K - $180K

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.

We’re a team of innovators using **AI at the core** to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

**Position Summary:**

Onit is seeking a strategic and customer-focused Customer Success Manager, ideally, with a background in State, Local, and Education legal operations to support our LegalFiles portfolio of customers. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor —partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure customer satisfaction, drive product adoption, and maximize value from Onit’s legal tech solutions. Your legal operations expertise will position you to effectively understand customer pain points, align platform capabilities to strategic goals, and guide clients through technical conversations, workflow optimizations, and platform best practices.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Build strong relationships with LegalFiles customers to understand their legal operations goals and drive value realization from Onit solutions.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic accounts, ensuring a seamless and proactive customer experience.
* Translate legal ops pain points (e.g., billing challenges, matter management gaps, workflow inefficiencies) into actionable technical solutions.
* Guide customers through onboarding, configuration recommendations, and best practices tailored to their maturity and objectives.
* Triage and manage support escalations, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Support to drive resolution and root cause analysis.
* Advocate internally for customer needs and product enhancements by identifying recurring themes and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct regular business reviews, usage assessments, and roadmap discussions to ensure alignment with customer goals.
* Document customer-specific workflows, integrations, and technical considerations to support continuity across internal teams.

### **Required Skills:**

* 5+ years of experience in a Customer Success or a customer-facing role (e.g., legal operations, vendor management, legal analyst, or customer success).
* Proven success supporting enterprise clients in a SaaS environment, preferably in B2B legal tech or enterprise software.
* Familiarity with legal ops processes including eBilling platforms, matter management, legal billing, and outside counsel guidelines is preferred.
* Awareness of audit practices and industry standards such as LEDES and UTBMS.
* Strong ability to engage with both technical stakeholders and non-technical legal ops users, advocating effectively for both.
* Experience mapping legal workflows and identifying opportunities for automation, efficiency, and process improvement.
* Strong organizational and communication skills, capable of managing multiple complex engagements simultaneously.
* Comfort navigating APIs, cloud platforms, and custom integrations.

At Onit, we’re committed to offering fair and competitive compensation. In addition to base pay, associates are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. The final base salary you receive will reflect factors such as your skills, education, experience, and work location.

**Benefits & Perks That Support You:**

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:

**Health Coverage Choices:** Three medical plan options, plus dental and vision, so you can choose what fits best. Employees on our HDHP plan also receive employer contribution to the HSA.

**Retirement Savings:** 401(k) with a 100% match on the first 3% and 50% on the next 2% of employee contributions.

**Time Away:** Flexible paid time off, 7 sick days, and 9 paid company holidays annually.

**Family Support:** Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.

**Income Protection:** 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.

**Additional Coverage Options:** Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident, and even pet insurance.

**Tax-Advantaged Accounts:** Healthcare FSA, HSA, and dependent care FSA.

**Community Engagement:** One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

**Our Commitment to Applicants**

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

This position will remain open for applications for 7 calendar days from the posting date.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
**The Role We Need**
--------------------

PadSplit is hiring a Host Account Manager to serve as the dedicated strategic partner and primary point of contact for a portfolio of PadSplit hosts. This is a newly created role at the heart of our Host Success model, designed to shift how we support all hosts from reactive problem-solving to proactive, relationship-driven account management.

You will own the full host relationship from activation through long-term retention. But owning the relationship means more than managing check-ins and reviewing dashboards. It means being atrusted partner and the person your hosts call when something goes wrong, someone who knows the platform, the policies, and the fee structures well enough to provide clear answers on the spot. You will be measured on the outcomes that matter most: your response times, occupancy performance, host satisfaction, churn reduction, and portfolio retention.

This role is critical to ensuring every host in your book of business has what they need to thrive on the platform, and that they feel it.

**The Person We Are Looking For**
---------------------------------

We are looking for a relationship-first operator who leads with data, follows through with hustle, and knows the product, policies, and PadSplit member outcomes well enough to earn a host’s trust in the first conversation. You are proactive by nature, the kind of person who spots a problem in a dashboard before a host ever has to call about it. You are also comfortable in the reactive moments: a confused host on the phone about a payout deduction, a complex situation involving a member that requires judgment and empathy in equal measure, a policy question that does not have a clean answer. You handle those moments with the same professionalism you bring to your scheduled portfolio reviews.

You understand that being a trusted partner requires genuine knowledge. You do not escalate everything, and you do not guess. You build the platform and policy fluency to be the person who actually resolves the issue, and you know when escalation is the right call.
