jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Join Evotix?**

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue **Excellence**, show **Leadership**, deliver **Impact**, earn **Trust**, and **Empower** those around them.

**Overview**

*The expected total earnings for this role is $100,000-150,000. This is made up of both a base salary and a commission package.*

Our customers already trust us. Your job is to keep that trust strong, and make it grow.

We truly value our customers. Happy, engaged customers renew. They renew for longer. And they buy more. That’s the chain this role runs on. You’ll own a large book of enterprise accounts, and your first job is making sure each customer is getting real value and feels heard. When they do, healthy, longer-term contracts and expansion follow.

You’ll work with **EHS Directors**, executives and budget holders, often in the same account at once. You’ll run many accounts, renewals, deals and stakeholders in parallel, and keep every one of them moving.

This is a fast, busy role. Priorities shift daily, deadlines are real, and the details matter. We need someone who thrives in that, stays organized under pressure, and acts with urgency.

**What You'll Do**

**Keep customers engaged and renewing**

* Build real relationships with day-to-day users, EHS Directors and executive sponsors in every account.
* Check in often and early. Know how each customer is doing, spot risk before it becomes a problem, and act fast.
* Own the renewal cycle from start to finish. Start conversations early, and aim for longer-term contracts, not short extensions.
* Work with Customer Success to make sure customers are adopting the product and getting results they can point to.
* Bring in the right people (Product, Implementation, leadership) when an account needs help.
* Your outcome: engaged customers, healthy contracts, and renewals that are on time and on longer terms.

**Grow our biggest accounts**

* Spot where Evotix can solve bigger problems, then sell additional modules and own expansion and upsell deals through to close.
* Study your customer base, then build account and territory plans that show where the next opportunity is.
* Sell consultatively to EHS Directors, C-level leaders and budget holders.
* Drive complex, multi-stakeholder deals to close, and prospect steadily to keep your pipeline full.
* Your outcome: a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline and wider adoption of the Evotix portfolio.
* **Deliver the best of Evotix**
* Work with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions Consulting and customer squads to find and move opportunities forward.
* Line up pricing, collateral and deal strategy with sales leadership, and bring in Implementation at the right moment.
* Partner with Events and Marketing to raise our profile in target accounts.
* Share customer needs, market insight and competitor moves with Product and Marketing.
* Your outcome: a seamless customer experience and a repeatable renewal, upsell and cross-sell playbook.
* **Keep the deal machine tight**
* Keep CRM records, pipeline data, activity and forecasts complete and accurate, including renewal dates and account health.
* Handle tenders, service order forms and purchase-order requirements.
* Negotiate terms with guidance from sales leadership and get agreements signed.
* Represent Evotix at conferences, exhibitions and industry forums. Customer visits and international travel may be required.
* Your outcome: well-run deals, forecasts people can trust, and a smooth handover to Implementation.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Experience selling SaaS software, with a track record of hitting revenue targets.
* Proven success keeping customers happy and renewing, ideally on multi-year terms.
* Proven success growing existing accounts through expansion, upsell or cross-sell.
* Strong consultative selling skills, including with senior executives and several decision-makers at once.
* Experience building account plans, generating pipeline and moving complex deals forward.
* Disciplined pipeline management and forecasting, with CRM habits you don’t skip.
* Excellent organization and prioritization. You can juggle many accounts and stakeholders without dropping details.
* A sense of urgency. You move fast, follow up fast and finish what you start.
* Clear writing, resilience and flexibility when plans change.
* A hungry, self-starting, collaborative style. You’re honest, you listen well and you build relationships easily.
* **Desirable**
* Experience selling EHS, health and safety, sustainability or related enterprise software.
* Experience helping shape renewal, expansion or team-selling playbooks.
* Time in a PE-backed SaaS company or another fast-scaling business.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager - Healthcare
jobs.description:
###### **About Vasion**

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

###### **About the role**

Vasion is looking for a Technical Account Manager who becomes the technical point of contact for our healthcare customers after the sale, working with hospital and health-system IT teams, from day-to-day administrators to IT directors, to keep the platform healthy, adopted, and growing long after go-live. We modernize how organizations handle documents, print, and content workflows, replacing fragmented legacy tools with a single, secure platform. In healthcare, that means print and document workflows that clinicians never have to think about, and IT teams that are never surprised.

###### **At a Glance**

* **Segment:** Healthcare accounts: hospitals, health systems, and multi-site provider networks
* **Vertical focus:** Healthcare
* **Engagement model:** Post-sales technical ownership across adoption, retention, and expansion
* **Work model:** Remote; ability to travel up to 20% [confirm]
* **Success metrics:** Gross retention on assigned accounts, risk identified before the customer raises it, adoption milestones met, expansion ARR influenced

###### **What Success Looks Like**

You find problems before our customers do. Every account in your book has a current technical plan that the customer's own technical owner has agreed to, and that plan already accounts for the EHR upgrade, the new clinic opening, and the audit that are coming. Escalations end with a root cause and a fix that holds. Renewals are a confirmation, not a negotiation, because the technical trust was built a year earlier.

###### **What you'll do**

**Ownership of the technical relationship across healthcare accounts: preventing risk, driving adoption, and growing customers over time.**

* **Proactive technical advisory:** Anticipate deployment, adoption, and stability risk across your accounts before the customer raises it. Turn release changes, configuration drift, and usage patterns into recommendations that name the risk, the likely impact, and the choice available to the customer, and be clear about which conclusions are firm and which need more evidence.
* **Technical account planning:** Own a twelve-month technical plan for each account, grounded in the health system's real growth, projects, and constraints, and agreed with the customer's technical owner. Keep a forward calendar of EHR upgrades and cutovers, new site openings, acquisitions, audits, and clinical change freezes, so Vasion hears about them before they arrive as escalations.
* **Clinical workflow adoption:** Help customers get the full value of what they already own, including secure pull and badge-based printing, serverless print management, and EHR-connected print and document workflows across shared clinical workstations and virtual desktops. Convert unused capability into adoption commitments.
* **Escalation leadership:** Lead the technical response when one of your accounts escalates, especially when printing or document delivery touches patient-facing operations. Coordinate Support and Engineering, give the customer one voice, and confirm the fix has held before closing it out.
* **Service delivery and renewal support:** Manage entitlement consumption across your book, coordinate Professional Services, Support, and partners, and give Customer Success the technical input needed to protect renewals, quarters ahead.
* **Expansion:** Identify new use cases inside the account, such as document workflow and capture needs, and build the technical case with Customer Success and Sales.
* **Field feedback and enablement:** Share healthcare field insight with Product and Engineering, and contribute runbooks, health-check templates, and reference architectures to the shared library.

###### **What You Bring**

**Strong technical grounding, healthcare IT fluency, and a structured approach to keeping accounts healthy and growing:**

* **Post-sales technical advisory:** Health reviews, adoption planning, review delivery, escalation coordination, and clear communication from IT administrator to Director level.
* **Architecture and systems thinking:** Ability to read and critique a customer's deployment architecture, including multi-site and virtualized environments.
* **Networking and identity:** Troubleshooting DNS, proxies, and firewalls; strong grasp of LDAP and SSO (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping), plus badge and tap-to-authenticate workflows such as Imprivata.
* **Security and compliance:** Working knowledge of HIPAA and HITECH requirements as they apply to print and output management; awareness of SOC 2 and ISO.
* **Domain expertise:** Print, Workflow, and Output Automation in cloud and hybrid environments; familiarity with EHR platforms (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner) and the print and document patterns around them.
* **Technical toolbox:** Diagramming; bash and/or PowerShell; SQL basics; RESTful APIs; Jira; AI-assisted workflows.

###### **Qualifications**

**Hands-on post-sales experience and the technical depth to earn trust with customer administrators:**

* 3-5+ years in technical account management, post-sales engineering, or senior technical support for SaaS or enterprise software
* Track record owning enterprise accounts through renewal cycles and escalations
* Comfortable engaging technical owners and decision makers, with strong writing and presentation skills
*

=============================

**Remote, United States**

FoodChain ID is looking for a results-driven Strategic Account Manager (SAM) to strengthen and grow relationships with our Mid-Market customers.

In this role, you'll serve as a trusted strategic partner, uncover new business opportunities, and drive revenue growth by connecting customer needs with FoodChain ID's broad portfolio of solutions, including software, data, testing, certification, and regulatory services.

We're looking for a commercially minded relationship builder who thrives on identifying opportunities, collaborating across teams, and delivering measurable results.

### **What You'll Do**

* Drive Account Growth: Develop and execute strategic account plans focused on customer retention, cross-selling, upselling, and expanding share of wallet.
* Own Revenue Targets: Manage an assigned customer portfolio, individual bookings goals, expansion pipeline, and revenue forecasts.
* Build Strategic Partnerships: Establish trusted relationships with key stakeholders, senior leaders, and executive decision-makers.
* Identify New Opportunities: Uncover customer needs and collaborate with specialist sales teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Strengthen Customer Retention: Proactively manage renewal opportunities, identify risks, and protect existing revenue.
* Lead Customer Engagement: Conduct strategic business reviews, customer meetings, and on-site visits to strengthen relationships and identify growth opportunities.
* Deliver Results: Leverage Salesforce, customer insights, and pipeline data to manage opportunities, forecast accurately, and consistently achieve KPIs.

### **What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in strategic account management, consultative B2B sales, or customer growth.
* Proven success achieving sales quotas and growing existing accounts through cross-selling, upselling, and solution expansion.
* Experience managing complex customer portfolios, renewals, commercial negotiations, and qualified sales pipelines.
* Strong ability to build executive-level relationships and navigate multiple customer stakeholders.
* Experience using CRM tools, ideally Salesforce, to manage opportunities, reporting, and forecasting.
* Experience in software/SaaS, data, professional services, testing, certification, regulatory solutions, or similar complex solution-based environments.
* Industry experience in food and beverage, consumer products, regulatory compliance, quality, sustainability, supply chain, or related sectors.
* Familiarity with customer success, account-based marketing, and cross-functional sales strategies.
* Ability to travel as needed to support customer relationships.

### **Why FoodChain ID?**

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Analyst

**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

* Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
* Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

**Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership**

* Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
* Build and own executive-grade dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni) reconciled against Salesforce and finance data, and own the analytics behind monthly/quarterly business reviews and QBRs.

* Hands-on dbt experience building production-grade, tested, documented models.

jobs.title: Instructional Designer

***Position is for an Instructional Designer OR Senior Instructional Designer***

**Position Summary**

The Sr. Instructional Designer is responsible for the design, development, and ongoing improvement of learning programs and training content that support organizational and workforce capability needs. The primary focus of this position is the creation of new training programs and the review and modernization of existing learning content.

This position applies instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies to translate business, technical, and operational requirements into structured and effective learning solutions. The Sr. Instructional Designer works closely with subject matter experts and key stakeholders to ensure training content is accurate, relevant, practical, and aligned with the needs of the organization and the energy industry.

The role requires a strong degree of independence and ownership. The Sr. Instructional Designer is expected to manage multiple learning initiatives simultaneously, establish and maintain project plans and priorities, coordinate content development and review activities, and drive work through completion with limited oversight.

**Primary Responsibilities**

· Design and develop new training programs based on identified business, workforce, and performance needs.

· Review, revise, and modernize existing training programs and learning materials to improve accuracy, relevance, consistency, and effectiveness.

· Apply instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and appropriate learning methodologies throughout the development process.

· Develop learning objectives, course structures, instructional content, assessments, facilitator materials, job aids, and other learning resources.

· Translate complex technical, operational, and business information into clear, structured, learner-focused content.

· Partner with subject matter experts to gather, validate, and organize technical and industry-specific information.

· Ensure training content reflects appropriate energy industry terminology, practices, processes, and operating context.

· Determine appropriate learning approaches and delivery methods based on the audience, subject matter, and desired performance outcomes.

· Establish and maintain standards, templates, and processes for training content development and maintenance.

· Manage multiple learning development projects, including project plans, timelines, stakeholder reviews, approvals, and deliverables.

· Maintain organized training documentation, source materials, content inventories, and version control.

· Establish processes for the periodic review and maintenance of existing learning content.

· Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs and use feedback, assessment results, and stakeholder input to identify opportunities for improvement.

· Independently identify issues, establish priorities, and drive learning initiatives from initial need through implementation.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

· Demonstrated knowledge of the energy industry, including an understanding of industry terminology, operations, business processes, and/or technical environments.

· Strong knowledge of instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and learning development methodologies.

· Demonstrated experience designing and developing training programs from initial concept through implementation.

· Experience evaluating, revising, and modernizing existing training content.

· Ability to synthesize complex technical or operational information and translate it into clear and effective learning content.

· Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

· Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of work with limited direction.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to content quality and accuracy.

· Ability to establish productive working relationships with technical subject matter experts, business leaders, and other stakeholders.

· Ability to facilitate in-person or virtual training, content-development discussions, resolve conflicting input, and move stakeholders toward decisions.

· Proficiency with learning technologies, eLearning development tools, and learning management systems appropriate to the organization.

**Education & Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Learning & Development, Education, Organizational Development, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

· Relevant professional experience in instructional design, learning and development, training development, or a related field.

Kaizen Global is a global technology consulting firm that helps organizations unlock the full value of their data through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and modern data platforms. We partner with clients across industries to solve complex business problems, modernize legacy systems, and drive measurable outcomes. At Kaizen, we combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative, people-first culture focused on continuous improvement. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution to deliver solutions that make a real impact.

The Business Analyst is a Kaizen consultant placed on client engagements, working as part of a client’s Enterprise Data team. You’ll report to a Kaizen engagement lead and get direction from senior Kaizen analysts and leads. Over time, you’ll own requirements for defined workstreams and become a trusted point of contact for client stakeholders.

* Track requirements from intake through development and testing so nothing gets lost

**Process Documentation**

* Help break epics into stories and size work with the delivery team

**Client Engagement and Kaizen Contribution**

* Pick up new client environments, tools, and business domains quickly as engagements change

  
Qualifications

* 1 to 3 years of experience in business analysis, data analysis, or a related role
* Basic understanding of data concepts such as tables, joins, data models, and metrics
* Strong writing skills, with the ability to turn unclear input into clear, structured requirements
* Clear, confident communication with both business and technical audiences
* Curiosity about how the business runs and how data supports decisions
* Interest in consulting and comfort working across different clients, industries, and team setups

**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

**Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership**

About Kaizen  
Kaizen Global is a global technology consulting firm that helps organizations unlock the full value of their data through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and modern data platforms. We partner with clients across industries to solve complex business problems, modernize legacy systems, and drive measurable outcomes. At Kaizen, we combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative, people-first culture focused on continuous improvement. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution to deliver solutions that make a real impact.  
  
Job Description  
The Business Analyst is a Kaizen consultant placed on client engagements, working as part of a client’s Enterprise Data team. You’ll work with a blended team of Kaizen and client staff, including business stakeholders, data engineers, BI developers, and product owners, to deliver data and analytics solutions. In this role, you’ll turn client business needs into clear requirements, document and improve analytical processes, and keep development work organized and moving in Jira.  
You’ll report to a Kaizen engagement lead and get direction from senior Kaizen analysts and leads. Over time, you’ll own requirements for defined workstreams and become a trusted point of contact for client stakeholders.  
  
Key Responsibilities  
**Requirements and Backlog Management**

* Gather and document requirements through client stakeholder interviews, working sessions, and reviews of existing documentation
* Write user stories with clear acceptance criteria and keep them current in Jira
* Work with senior BAs and product owners to refine and prioritize the backlog
* Track requirements from intake through development and testing so nothing gets lost

**Analytical Process Analysis and Improvement**

* Learn and break down the client’s core business processes – often analytical in nature – that help run the business. This includes key reporting, core system process enhancements, KPI calculations, and data handoffs
* Find pain points, manual workarounds, data quality gaps, and chances to simplify or automate
* Help shape solution options and recommend improvements with the data and BI teams

**Process Documentation**

* Map current-state and future-state workflows using process flows and swimlane diagrams
* Keep documentation clear and current in Confluence or team repositories

**Data and Analytics Solution Support**

* Quickly build a working knowledge of each client’s data landscape: source systems, pipelines, the data warehouse, and reporting layers
* Document data definitions, business rules, source-to-target mappings, and data dictionaries
* Write basic SQL queries to explore data, validate requirements, and support testing
* Review, troubleshoot, or build basic Power BI reports and DAX measures to understand how metrics are calculated and shown
* Create low-fidelity wireframes so stakeholders agree on a design before development starts

**Core BA Artifacts**

* Help create the BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process maps, data mappings, and test cases that development and business teams rely on

**Sprint and Long-Term Planning**

* Take part in sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, and retrospectives
* Help break epics into stories and size work with the delivery team
* Support quarterly and roadmap planning by organizing requirements, dependencies, and priorities

**Client Engagement and Kaizen Contribution**

* Represent Kaizen professionally with client teams and build strong working relationships
* Keep the Kaizen engagement lead updated on progress, risks, and scope questions
* Follow Kaizen delivery standards and contribute to internal templates, best practices, and knowledge sharing
* Pick up new client environments, tools, and business domains quickly as engagements change

  
Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field
* 1 to 3 years of experience in business analysis, data analysis, or a related role
* Basic understanding of data concepts such as tables, joins, data models, and metrics
* Strong writing skills, with the ability to turn unclear input into clear, structured requirements
* Clear, confident communication with both business and technical audiences
* Curiosity about how the business runs and how data supports decisions
* Interest in consulting and comfort working across different clients, industries, and team setups
* Organized and detail-oriented, and comfortable asking questions
* Familiarity with the following tools:
  + Microsoft Office: Excel, Word, PowerPoint (strong Excel skills expected)
  + Jira: creating and managing stories and epics (Confluence a plus)
  + Power BI: basic report building and DAX
